source.text: Καὶ ὑμᾶς ὄντας νεκροὺς τοῖς παραπτώμασιν καὶ ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ὑμῶν, ἐν αἷς ποτε περιεπατήσατε κατὰ τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ κόσμου τούτου, κατὰ τὸν ἄρχοντα τῆς ἐξουσίας τοῦ ἀέρος, τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ νῦν ἐνεργοῦντος ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς τῆς ἀπειθείας·

records.literal_gloss: And you being dead in the trespasses and the sins of you, \v 2 in which once you walked according to the age of the world this, according to the ruler of the authority of the air, of the spirit the [one] now working in the sons of the disobedience;

en.L: And you, being dead in your trespasses and sins, \v 2 in which you once walked according to the age of this world, according to the ruler of the authority of the air, of the spirit that is now working in the {{gender:children|sons}} of disobedience;
en.B: As for you, you were dead in your trespasses and sins. \v 2 You once lived in them, following the way of this world in its present age and following the ruler of the realm of the air, the ruler of the spirit now at work in those who disobey.
en.R: Once you were spiritually dead because of the wrong things you did and the sins you committed. \v 2 That is how you used to live. You followed the ways of this world as it is now. You obeyed the devil, who rules the realm of the air. He is the ruler of the spirit that is now at work in people who refuse to obey God.

es.L: Y a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, estando muertos en {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} delitos y pecados, \v 2 en los cuales {{plural_you:anduvieron|anduvisteis}} en otro tiempo conforme a la era de este mundo, conforme al gobernante de la autoridad del aire, del espíritu que ahora actúa en los hijos de la desobediencia;
es.B: En cuanto a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:estaban|estabais}} muertos en {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} delitos y pecados. \v 2 En ellos {{plural_you:vivían|vivíais}} en otro tiempo, siguiendo el camino de este mundo en su era presente y siguiendo al gobernante del dominio del aire, el que gobierna también el espíritu que ahora actúa en los que desobedecen.
es.R: Antes {{plural_you:ustedes estaban|vosotros estabais}} muertos espiritualmente a causa del mal que {{plural_you:hacían|hacíais}} y de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pecados. \v 2 Así {{plural_you:vivían|vivíais}}. {{plural_you:Seguían|Seguíais}} los caminos de este mundo tal como es ahora. {{plural_you:Obedecían|Obedecíais}} al diablo, que gobierna el dominio del aire. Él gobierna el espíritu que ahora actúa en la gente que se niega a obedecer a Dios.

sw.L: Nanyi, mkiwa wafu katika makosa yenu na dhambi zenu, \v 2 ambazo ndani yake mlienenda zamani kufuatana na enzi ya ulimwengu huu, kufuatana na mtawala wa mamlaka ya anga, wa roho inayofanya kazi sasa ndani ya wana wa kutotii;
sw.B: Ninyi mlikuwa wafu katika makosa yenu na dhambi zenu. \v 2 Zamani mliishi katika mambo hayo, mkifuata njia ya ulimwengu huu katika enzi hii ya sasa, na mkimfuata mtawala wa milki ya anga, anayetawala pia roho ile inayofanya kazi sasa ndani ya wale wasiotii.
sw.R: Zamani mlikuwa wafu kiroho kwa sababu ya mabaya mliyotenda na dhambi mlizofanya. \v 2 Ndivyo mlivyoishi zamani. Mlifuata njia za ulimwengu huu kama ulivyo sasa. Mlimtii Shetani, anayetawala milki ya anga. Yeye ndiye mtawala wa roho ile inayofanya kazi sasa ndani ya watu wanaokataa kumtii Mungu.

fr.L: Et vous, étant morts dans vos fautes et vos péchés, \v 2 dans lesquels vous avez marché autrefois selon l’âge de ce monde, selon le prince de l’autorité de l’air, de l’esprit qui opère maintenant dans les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de la désobéissance ;
fr.B: Quant à vous, vous étiez morts dans vos fautes et vos péchés. \v 2 C’est en eux que vous avez vécu autrefois, en suivant les façons de ce monde dans le temps présent et en suivant le chef qui domine le royaume de l’air, le chef de l’esprit qui agit maintenant en ceux qui désobéissent.
fr.R: Autrefois, vous étiez morts spirituellement à cause du mal que vous faisiez et des péchés que vous commettiez. \v 2 C’est ainsi que vous viviez. Vous suiviez les façons de vivre de ce monde tel qu’il est aujourd’hui. Vous obéissiez au diable, qui domine le royaume de l’air. C’est lui qui commande l’esprit qui agit maintenant chez les gens qui refusent d’obéir à Dieu.

ko.L: 그리고 여러분은, 여러분의 범죄들과 죄들 가운데서 죽어 있었던 여러분은— \v 2 여러분은 전에 그 가운데서 이 세상의 세대를 따라, 공중의 권세를 잡은 통치자, 곧 지금 불순종의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들 가운데서 일하는 영[을 다스리는 자]를 따라 걸었습니다.
ko.B: 여러분으로 말하자면, 여러분은 범죄와 죄 가운데서 죽어 있었습니다. \v 2 여러분은 전에 그 가운데서 살면서, 지금 이 세대의 세상 풍조를 따르고, 공중의 권세를 잡은 통치자를 따랐습니다. 그는 지금 순종하지 않는 사람들 가운데서 일하는 영을 다스리는 자입니다.
ko.R: 한때 여러분은 여러분이 저지른 잘못과 죄 때문에 영적으로 죽은 사람이었습니다. \v 2 그때 여러분은 그렇게 살았습니다. 여러분은 지금 이 세상이 사는 방식을 따랐습니다. 여러분은 마귀에게 순종했습니다. 마귀는 공중의 영역을 다스리는 자입니다. 그는 지금 하나님께 순종하기를 거부하는 사람들 가운데서 일하고 있는 영을 다스립니다.

vi.L: Còn anh chị em, là những người đã chết trong những vi phạm và tội lỗi của mình, \v 2 là những điều anh chị em đã bước đi trong đó trước kia, theo thời đại của thế gian này, theo kẻ cai trị quyền lực trên không trung, là thần linh hiện đang hành động trong những con cái của sự bất tuân;
vi.B: Còn anh chị em, anh chị em đã chết trong những vi phạm và tội lỗi của mình. \v 2 Trước kia anh chị em đã sống trong những điều ấy, theo đường lối của thế gian này trong thời đại hiện nay, và theo kẻ cai trị cõi không trung, là kẻ cai trị thần linh hiện đang hành động trong những người không vâng phục.
vi.R: Trước kia anh chị em đã chết về phần tâm linh vì những điều sai trái anh chị em đã làm và những tội lỗi anh chị em đã phạm. \v 2 Anh chị em đã sống như vậy. Anh chị em đã theo lối sống của thế gian này như hiện nay. Anh chị em đã vâng theo ma quỷ, là kẻ cai trị cõi không trung. Nó cai trị thần linh hiện đang hành động trong những người không chịu vâng lời Đức Chúa Trời.

pt.L: E vocês, estando mortos nas faltas e nos pecados de vocês, \v 2 nos quais outrora andaram segundo a era deste mundo, segundo o governante da autoridade do ar, do espírito que agora atua nos filhos da desobediência;
pt.B: Quanto a vocês, vocês estavam mortos nas suas faltas e pecados, \v 2 nos quais viveram no passado, seguindo o caminho deste mundo na sua era presente e seguindo o governante do domínio do ar, o governante do espírito que agora atua nos que desobedecem.
pt.R: Antes vocês estavam espiritualmente mortos por causa das coisas erradas que faziam e dos pecados que cometiam. \v 2 Era assim que vocês viviam. Vocês seguiam os costumes deste mundo como ele é agora. Vocês obedeciam ao diabo, que governa o domínio do ar. Ele é o governante do espírito que agora age nas pessoas que se recusam a obedecer a Deus.

am.L: እናንተንም በበደላችሁና በኃጢአታችሁ ሙታን የነበራችሁትን፣ \v 2 በእነርሱ ቀድሞ እንደዚህ ዓለም ዘመን፣ እንደ አየሩ ሥልጣን አለቃ፣ አሁን በአለመታዘዝ ልጆች ውስጥ እንደሚሠራው መንፈስ [አለቃ] የተመላለሳችሁባቸውን፤
am.B: እናንተ ደግሞ በበደላችሁና በኃጢአታችሁ ሙታን ነበራችሁ። \v 2 ቀድሞ በእነርሱ ትኖሩ ነበር፤ የዚህን ዓለም የአሁኑን ዘመን መንገድ ትከተሉ ነበር፤ የአየሩን ግዛት ገዢም ትከተሉ ነበር፤ እርሱም አሁን በማይታዘዙት ውስጥ የሚሠራው መንፈስ ገዢ ነው።
am.R: ቀድሞ በሠራችሁት በደልና በፈጸማችሁት ኃጢአት ምክንያት በመንፈስ ሙታን ነበራችሁ። \v 2 ትኖሩ የነበረው እንደዚህ ነው። የዚህን ዓለም የአሁኑን መንገድ ትከተሉ ነበር። የአየሩን ግዛት የሚገዛውን ዲያብሎስን ትታዘዙ ነበር። እርሱ እግዚአብሔርን አንታዘዝም በሚሉ ሰዎች ውስጥ አሁን የሚሠራው መንፈስ ገዢ ነው።

hi.L: और तुम, जो अपने अपराधों और पापों में मरे हुए थे, \v 2 जिनमें तुम पहले इस संसार के युग के अनुसार, वायु के अधिकार के अधिपति के अनुसार चलते थे, उस आत्मा के [अधिपति के अनुसार] जो अब आज्ञा न माननेवाली {{gender:सन्तान|पुत्रों}} में कार्य करता है;
hi.B: जहाँ तक तुम्हारी बात है, तुम अपने अपराधों और पापों में मरे हुए थे। \v 2 तुम पहले उन्हीं में जीते थे, इस संसार के वर्तमान युग की रीति के अनुसार, और वायुमंडल के राज्य के शासक के अनुसार, उस आत्मा के शासक के अनुसार जो अब उन लोगों में कार्य करता है जो आज्ञा नहीं मानते।
hi.R: पहले तुम आत्मिक रूप से मरे हुए थे, उन ग़लत कामों के कारण जो तुमने किए और उन पापों के कारण जो तुमने किए। \v 2 तुम पहले ऐसे ही जीते थे। तुम इस संसार की आज की रीतियों पर चलते थे। तुम शैतान की बात मानते थे, जो वायुमंडल के राज्य पर शासन करता है। वह उस आत्मा का शासक है जो अब उन लोगों में काम कर रहा है जो परमेश्वर की आज्ञा मानने से इनकार करते हैं।

ru.L: И вас, мёртвых в ваших прегрешениях и грехах, \v 2 в которых вы когда-то ходили, следуя веку этого мира, следуя правителю власти воздуха, духа, который ныне действует в {{gender:детях|сыновьях}} непослушания;
ru.B: Вы же были мертвы из-за своих прегрешений и грехов. \v 2 Когда-то вы жили в них, следуя пути этого мира в его нынешнем веке и следуя правителю воздушного царства, правителю духа, который теперь действует в непокорных.
ru.R: Когда-то вы были духовно мертвы из-за плохих поступков, которые вы совершали, и грехов, которые вы делали. \v 2 Так вы жили раньше. Вы жили по обычаям этого мира, каким он стал теперь. Вы слушались дьявола, который правит в воздушном царстве. Он — правитель духа, который сейчас действует в людях, отказывающихся слушаться Бога.

uk.L: І вас, які були мертві у ваших провинах і гріхах, \v 2 у яких ви колись ходили за віком цього світу, за володарем влади повітря, духа, що тепер діє в {{gender:дітях|синах}} непокори;
uk.B: А ви були мертві у своїх провинах і гріхах. \v 2 Колись ви жили в них, ідучи шляхом цього світу в його теперішньому віці й ідучи за володарем царства повітря, володарем духа, який тепер діє в тих, хто не кориться.
uk.R: Колись ви були духовно мертві через погане, що робили, і гріхи, які чинили. \v 2 Так ви тоді жили. Ви йшли за звичаями цього світу, яким він є тепер. Ви корилися дияволові, який панує в царстві повітря. Він — володар духа, що тепер діє в людях, які не хочуть коритися Богові.

ja.L: そして、自分の過ちと罪のうちに死んでいたあなたがたを――\v 2 あなたがたはかつて、その中で、この世の時代にしたがい、空中の権威の支配者、すなわち今も不従順の子らのうちに働いている霊の[支配者]にしたがって歩んでいました。
ja.B: あなたがたはといえば、自分の過ちと罪のうちに死んでいました。\v 2 あなたがたはかつて、その中で生きていました。今の時代のこの世のやり方にしたがい、空中の領域を支配する者にしたがっていたのです。この者は、今も従わない者たちのうちに働いている霊を支配しています。
ja.R: かつて、みなさんは自分がした悪いことと罪のために、霊的に死んでいました。\v 2 それが、みなさんの以前の生き方でした。みなさんは、今のこの世の生き方に従っていました。空中の領域を支配する悪魔に従っていたのです。悪魔は、神に従おうとしない人々のうちに今も働いている霊を支配しています。

decisions.choice: the opening "you" waits for its verb: Paul breaks off and takes the sentence up again in verse 5, where God "made us alive together with Christ"
alternatives: supply "he made alive" here from verse 5
decisions.reason: ὑμᾶς is the object of a verb that never comes in verses 1-3. Paul describes what his readers were (verses 1-2) and what all believers were (verse 3), then starts again with ὁ δὲ θεὸς ("but God", verse 4), and the verb arrives in verse 5 with "us" in place of "you". The break makes the contrast sharp: dead, but God made alive. The record follows the SBLGNT, which ends the sentence at verse 2.

decisions.choice: dead in trespasses and sins: cut off from the life of God because of wrongdoing, and living in it
decisions.reason: They were alive in the ordinary sense, since they "walked" in these sins (verse 2). νεκροὺς means they had no share in God's life (4:18; Colossians 2:13), and could not give themselves life; only God could (verse 5). παραπτώμασιν (false steps) and ἁμαρτίαις (sins, missing the mark) are two words for the same thing, all their wrongdoing. The dative says both why they were dead and the condition they lived in.

decisions.choice: walked: lived, conducted their lives
decisions.reason: περιεπατήσατε ("you walked") is a Hebrew way of speaking of how a person lives (Psalm 1:1). Paul ends this passage with the same verb: believers are to walk in good works (verse 10).

decisions.choice: the age of this world: the world as it is in the present age, with its values and ways, set against God
alternatives: a personal spiritual power named Aeon
decisions.reason: αἰῶνα normally means an age or era. Paul speaks of "this age" as the present time that opposes God (Romans 12:2; Galatians 1:4), and of "the god of this age" (2 Corinthians 4:4). The word was later used for spiritual beings, but here it stands beside κόσμου ("world") and names a way of life, which the next phrase then traces to a personal ruler.

decisions.choice: the ruler of the authority of the air: the devil, ruling the realm where evil spiritual powers are at work
decisions.reason: ἄρχοντα is a ruler; the letter later names the devil and the spiritual forces of evil "in the heavenly places" as the believer's real enemy (6:11-12). Jesus calls him "the ruler of this world" (John 12:31). ἐξουσίας here is the domain where his authority runs, and may include the powers under him.

decisions.choice: the air: the region between the earth and the heavens
alternatives: the atmosphere in a merely physical sense
decisions.reason: ἀέρος is the air around and above the earth, below the heavens. In Jewish and other writing of the time this lower sky was often pictured as the place where evil spirits were active. Paul uses the picture to say that this ruler's power is near and real, not far away.

decisions.choice: the spirit now at work in the disobedient is something the ruler rules: a power and influence that works in people, under his control
alternatives: the spirit is the ruler himself, named a second way
the spirit is the same as "the authority of the air"
decisions.reason: τοῦ πνεύματος is genitive, like ἐξουσίας before it, so the easiest reading makes both depend on ἄρχοντα: he rules the realm of the air and also the spirit that works in disobedient people. If the spirit were the ruler himself, the case would be expected to match ἄρχοντα. The sense is close either way: the devil is behind the way they lived.

decisions.choice: the sons of disobedience: people whose lives are marked by disobedience to God
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 3:6 and Ephesians 5:6, "sons of" something is a Hebrew way of saying people characterized by it. It includes men and women. ἀπειθείας is refusal to obey God, which in the New Testament includes refusing to believe the gospel (Romans 11:30-32).

decisions.choice: As for you, you were dead
alternatives: And you, being dead (with the verb left until verse 5)
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the broken sentence a verb so that it can be read on its own; the main verb, "made alive", comes in verse 5 (m1).

decisions.choice: {{gender:children|sons}} of disobedience
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 3:6, the phrase means people of either sex (m8); "sons" is the traditional form. Balanced and Readable say "those who disobey", which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: spiritually dead because of the wrong things you did
decisions.reason: Readable says what kind of death is meant (m2), and uses plainer words than "trespasses", as in Colossians 2:13.

decisions.choice: lived; used to live
decisions.reason: "Walked" for a way of life is an idiom (m3); Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: You obeyed the devil, who rules the realm of the air ... people who refuse to obey God
alternatives: the ruler of the authority of the air
decisions.reason: Readable names the ruler (m5) and says who is disobeyed (m8).

decisions.choice: ustedes / vosotros forms
decisions.reason: Paul writes to his readers in the plural throughout the chapter. Every plural "you" and its verb is a reader setting: ustedes (Latin America, the default) or vosotros (Spain), as in Philippians.

decisions.choice: hijos de la desobediencia, no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English offers "sons" as the traditional form. Spanish "hijos" already covers sons and daughters, as in John 1:12, so the Spanish has no gender span here. Balanced and Readable say "los que desobedecen" and "la gente que se niega a obedecer", as the English does.

decisions.choice: wana wa kutotii, no gender setting
decisions.reason: "Wana" means children of either sex, so Swahili has no gender span where the English offers "sons" (docs/swahili-style.md 7). "Kutotii" (not obeying) is ἀπειθείας as refusing to obey God (m8); "uasi" (rebellion) says more.

decisions.choice: roho inayofanya kazi (class 9 agreement)
decisions.reason: The spirit here is a power under the ruler, not the ruler himself (m7). Swahili lets "roho" take either personal agreement (anayefanya) or the agreement of its noun class (inayofanya); the class 9 form keeps it a force at work in people and stops a reader taking it for the ruler or for God's Spirit.

decisions.choice: the settings, "passé composé" and the terms set out in chapter 1 hold for this chapter; les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de la désobéissance (L)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 3:6, "enfants" is the inclusive default for the Hebrew way of speaking of people marked by something (m8), with "fils" as the traditional form. Balanced and Readable say "ceux qui désobéissent", already inclusive. "Fautes" is used for the Greek word for false steps at Literal and Balanced, as in Colossians 2:13.

decisions.choice: vous avez marché (L), vous avez vécu (B, R); le prince (L), le chef (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of "walking" for a way of life (m3), which recurs through the letter (2:10, 4:1, 4:17, 5:2, 5:8, 5:15). "Prince" is the traditional French title for this ruler; Balanced says "chef", and Readable names him (m5).

decisions.choice: Literal names "여러분" twice and breaks off with a dash, as the Greek breaks off before its verb
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says the opening "you" waits for its verb until verse 5. Korean can show the break, as in Colossians 1:21; Literal then lets verse 2 stand as its own sentence so that the verse keeps its content after its marker. Balanced and Readable write plain sentences.

decisions.choice: {{gender:자녀|아들}}들 (L); "순종하지 않는 사람들" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 3:6: Korean has two ways of saying the Hebrew idiom "sons of", "자녀들" and the traditional "아들들". Balanced and Readable say "사람들", which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: "공중의 권세를 잡은 통치자" (L, B); "마귀 ... 공중의 영역을 다스리는 자" (R)
decisions.reason: The ruler is the devil (the meaning decision), who takes no honorific. Literal and Balanced keep the Greek's description; Readable names him, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "những vi phạm" (L, B), "những điều sai trái" (R) for trespasses; "tội lỗi" for sins
decisions.reason: The words of the Vietnamese Colossians (2:13) for the same pair; "vi phạm" is a false step against what is right.

decisions.choice: "kẻ cai trị", "thần linh" (lowercase); "nó" for the devil (R)
decisions.reason: The ruler is the devil (m5), so he is spoken of as "kẻ" and, at Readable, "nó", the ordinary pronouns for a hostile being, as the Vietnamese Colossians does for the defeated powers (2:15). The spirit at work in the disobedient is a power under his control (m7), so it is "thần linh" in lower case, never "Thánh Linh".

decisions.choice: "những con cái của sự bất tuân" (L), with no gender span
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Colossians (3:6), "con cái" already includes sons and daughters, so the English setting has nothing to choose between.

decisions.choice: filhos da desobediência, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English needs a setting to choose between "children" and "sons". Portuguese "filhos" already means sons and daughters together, so the Hebrew idiom for people marked by disobedience (m8) needs no setting; the same in 5:6.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: As in the chapters before: the Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God and Christ in English (from 2:4 on) has nothing to change in Amharic; the pronouns and verb endings are written plainly through this chapter.

decisions.choice: ተመላለሳችሁ (you walked, L); ትኖሩ ነበር (you lived, B, R)
decisions.reason: Paul's 'walk' for the way a life is lived (meaning decision m3) comes back through the letter (2:10; 4:1, 17; 5:2, 8, 15). Literal keeps it as "መመላለስ", the Amharic verb for going about one's life, as in Romans; Balanced and Readable say "መኖር".

decisions.choice: የአለመታዘዝ ልጆች (children of disobedience), with no gender span
decisions.reason: "ልጆች" already means sons and daughters, and "ወንዶች ልጆች" would stress maleness, which the Hebrew-style idiom does not intend (meaning decision m8); there is no second wording for the setting to switch to.

decisions.choice: आज्ञा न माननेवाली {{gender:सन्तान|पुत्रों}}
decisions.reason: The phrase means people of either sex whose lives are marked by disobedience (meaning decision m8), so Literal has the sons span of Romans, with the adjective in the form that fits both options; Balanced and Readable say "people", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "चलते थे" (L); "जीते थे" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Walked" for a way of life is an idiom (meaning decision m3); Literal keeps it, the other levels say "lived". The same in verse 10.

decisions.choice: "वायु" (L); "वायुमंडल" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The air is the region between the earth and the heavens (meaning decision m6); "आकाश" would suggest the sky or the heavens themselves.

decisions.choice: {{gender:детях|сыновьях}} непослушания
decisions.reason: As in English: the phrase means people of either sex (m8); the traditional form is the alternative. Balanced and Readable say "непокорные", "люди", already inclusive.

decisions.choice: ходили
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the walking idiom for a way of life (m3); Balanced and Readable say "жили".

decisions.choice: володар
decisions.reason: "Князь" (the familiar "князь власті повітря") is now a title of nobility; "володар" says plainly that he rules.

decisions.choice: "……あなたがたを――" (L)
alternatives: a complete sentence at Literal, as at Balanced
decisions.reason: The Greek "you" is an object whose verb never comes in verses 1-3; Paul starts again in verse 5 (m1). Literal keeps the object with を and breaks off with a dash, so the reader sees the broken sentence; Balanced and Readable give it a verb, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "不従順の子ら" with no gender span (L)
decisions.reason: The English needs a span for "children/sons". Japanese 子ら already takes in women and men (m8), so no span is needed. Balanced and Readable say "those who do not obey", as the English does.

source.text: ἐν οἷς καὶ ἡμεῖς πάντες ἀνεστράφημέν ποτε ἐν ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις τῆς σαρκὸς ἡμῶν, ποιοῦντες τὰ θελήματα τῆς σαρκὸς καὶ τῶν διανοιῶν, καὶ ἤμεθα τέκνα φύσει ὀργῆς ὡς καὶ οἱ λοιποί·

records.literal_gloss: among whom also we all lived once in the desires of the flesh of us, doing the wishes of the flesh and of the thoughts, and we were children by nature of wrath as also the rest;

en.L: among whom we also all once lived in the desires of our flesh, doing the wishes of the flesh and of the thoughts, and we were children of wrath by nature, as the rest also [were].
en.B: We all once lived among them too, following the desires of our flesh and doing whatever our flesh and our thoughts wanted. By nature we deserved God's wrath, just like the rest of humanity.
en.R: All of us used to live among those people too. We did whatever our sinful nature wanted. We followed its desires and the plans of our own minds. By our very nature we deserved God's anger, just like everyone else.

es.L: entre los cuales también todos nosotros nos conducíamos en otro tiempo en los deseos de nuestra carne, haciendo las voluntades de la carne y de los pensamientos, y éramos hijos de ira por naturaleza, como también los demás [lo eran].
es.B: También todos nosotros vivíamos antes entre ellos, siguiendo los deseos de nuestra carne y haciendo lo que querían nuestra carne y nuestros pensamientos. Por naturaleza merecíamos la ira de Dios, igual que el resto de la humanidad.
es.R: Todos nosotros también vivíamos antes entre esa gente. Hacíamos todo lo que quería nuestra naturaleza pecadora. Seguíamos sus deseos y los planes de nuestra propia mente. Por nuestra misma naturaleza merecíamos la ira de Dios, igual que todos los demás.

sw.L: miongoni mwa hao sisi pia sote tuliishi zamani katika tamaa za mwili wetu, tukifanya matakwa ya mwili na ya mawazo, na tulikuwa kwa asili watoto wa ghadhabu kama wengine nao [walivyokuwa].
sw.B: Sisi sote pia tuliishi zamani miongoni mwao, tukifuata tamaa za utu wetu wa dhambi na kufanya kila kitu ambacho utu huo na mawazo yetu vilitaka. Kwa asili tulistahili ghadhabu ya Mungu, sawa na wanadamu wengine wote.
sw.R: Sisi sote pia tuliishi zamani katikati ya watu hao. Tulifanya kila kitu ambacho utu wetu wa dhambi ulitaka. Tulifuata tamaa zake na mipango ya akili zetu wenyewe. Kwa asili yetu tulistahili ghadhabu ya Mungu, sawa na watu wengine wote.

fr.L: parmi lesquels nous aussi, nous tous, nous avons vécu autrefois dans les convoitises de notre chair, faisant les volontés de la chair et des pensées, et nous étions par nature des enfants de colère, comme les autres aussi.
fr.B: Nous tous aussi, nous avons vécu autrefois parmi eux, en suivant les désirs de notre chair et en faisant tout ce que voulaient notre chair et nos pensées. Par nature, nous méritions la colère de Dieu, comme le reste de l’humanité.
fr.R: Nous tous, nous vivions nous aussi parmi ces gens-là. Nous faisions tout ce que voulait notre nature pécheresse. Nous suivions ses désirs et les projets de notre propre esprit. Par notre nature même, nous méritions la colère de Dieu, comme tout le monde.

ko.L: 우리도 모두 전에 그들 가운데서 우리 육신의 욕망 가운데 살며, 육신과 생각들이 원하는 것을 행하였고, 다른 사람들과 마찬가지로 본래 진노의 자녀였습니다.
ko.B: 우리도 모두 전에는 그들 가운데서 살면서, 우리 육신의 욕망을 따라 육신과 생각이 원하는 대로 다 행했습니다. 그래서 우리도 다른 모든 사람과 마찬가지로 본래 하나님의 진노를 받아 마땅한 사람들이었습니다.
ko.R: 우리도 모두 전에는 그런 사람들 가운데서 살았습니다. 우리는 죄에 끌리는 본성이 원하는 것은 무엇이든 했습니다. 그 욕망과 우리 자신의 생각이 바라는 대로 따라갔습니다. 우리는 본래 하나님의 진노를 받아 마땅한 사람들이었습니다. 다른 모든 사람과 똑같았습니다.

vi.L: trong số những người ấy, tất cả chúng ta cũng đã từng sống trong những dục vọng của xác thịt mình, làm theo những ý muốn của xác thịt và của các ý tưởng, và bản chất chúng ta là con cái của cơn thịnh nộ, như những người khác vậy;
vi.B: Tất cả chúng ta cũng đã từng sống giữa họ, theo những dục vọng của xác thịt mình, làm bất cứ điều gì xác thịt và tư tưởng mình muốn. Bản chất chúng ta đáng chịu cơn thịnh nộ của Đức Chúa Trời, cũng như mọi người khác.
vi.R: Tất cả chúng ta cũng đã từng sống giữa những người ấy. Chúng ta làm bất cứ điều gì bản tính tội lỗi của mình muốn. Chúng ta làm theo những ham muốn của nó và những dự tính trong tâm trí mình. Chính bản chất của chúng ta đáng chịu cơn giận của Đức Chúa Trời, cũng như mọi người khác.

pt.L: entre os quais também nós todos outrora vivemos nos desejos da nossa carne, fazendo as vontades da carne e dos pensamentos, e éramos por natureza filhos da ira, como também os demais.
pt.B: Todos nós também vivemos no passado entre eles, seguindo os desejos da nossa carne e fazendo tudo o que a nossa carne e os nossos pensamentos queriam. Por natureza merecíamos a ira de Deus, assim como o resto da humanidade.
pt.R: Todos nós também vivíamos no meio dessas pessoas. Fazíamos tudo o que a nossa natureza pecadora queria. Seguíamos os desejos dela e os planos da nossa própria mente. Pela nossa própria natureza, merecíamos a ira de Deus, como todos os outros.

am.L: በእነርሱም መካከል እኛ ደግሞ ሁላችን ቀድሞ በሥጋችን ምኞት ኖርን፤ የሥጋንና የአሳቦችን ፈቃዶች እያደረግን፣ እንደ ሌሎቹም ደግሞ በተፈጥሮ የቁጣ ልጆች ነበርን።
am.B: እኛ ሁላችንም ደግሞ ቀድሞ በመካከላቸው ኖርን፤ የሥጋችንን ምኞት እየተከተልን ሥጋችንና አሳባችን የፈለገውን ሁሉ እናደርግ ነበር። እንደ ሌላው የሰው ዘር ሁሉ በተፈጥሮአችን የእግዚአብሔር ቁጣ ይገባን ነበር።
am.R: ሁላችንም ደግሞ ቀድሞ በእነዚያ ሰዎች መካከል እንኖር ነበር። ኃጢአተኛ ተፈጥሮአችን የፈለገውን ሁሉ እናደርግ ነበር። ምኞቱንና የአእምሮአችንን ዕቅድ እንከተል ነበር። እንደ ሌሎቹ ሰዎች ሁሉ በተፈጥሮአችን የእግዚአብሔር ቁጣ ይገባን ነበር።

hi.L: जिनमें हम सब भी पहले अपने शरीर की लालसाओं में जीवन बिताते थे, और शरीर और विचारों की इच्छाएँ पूरी करते थे, और बाक़ी लोगों की तरह स्वभाव से क्रोध की सन्तान थे।
hi.B: हम सब भी पहले उन्हीं के बीच रहते थे, अपने शरीर की लालसाओं के पीछे चलते थे, और जो कुछ हमारा शरीर और हमारे विचार चाहते थे, वही करते थे। स्वभाव से ही हम बाक़ी सारी मानवजाति की तरह परमेश्वर के क्रोध के योग्य थे।
hi.R: हम सब भी पहले उन लोगों के बीच ऐसे ही जीते थे। हम वही करते थे जो हमारा शारीरिक स्वभाव चाहता था। हम उसकी इच्छाओं और अपने मन की योजनाओं के पीछे चलते थे। अपने स्वभाव से ही हम परमेश्वर के क्रोध के योग्य थे, बाक़ी सब लोगों की तरह।

ru.L: среди которых и мы все когда-то жили в похотях нашей плоти, исполняя желания плоти и помыслов, и были по природе детьми гнева, как и прочие.
ru.B: Мы все когда-то тоже жили среди них, следуя желаниям нашей плоти и исполняя всё, чего хотели наша плоть и наши мысли. По природе мы заслуживали Божьего гнева, как и все остальные люди.
ru.R: Все мы когда-то тоже жили среди этих людей. Мы делали всё, чего хотела наша греховная природа. Мы следовали её желаниям и замыслам своего ума. По самой своей природе мы заслуживали Божьего гнева, как и все остальные.

uk.L: серед яких і ми всі колись жили в пожадливостях нашого тіла, виконуючи бажання тіла й думок, і були за природою дітьми гніву, як і решта.
uk.B: Серед них і ми всі колись жили, ідучи за пожадливостями нашого тіла й роблячи все, чого хотіли наше тіло і наші думки. За своєю природою ми заслуговували на Божий гнів, так само як і решта людей.
uk.R: Усі ми теж колись жили серед цих людей. Ми робили все, чого хотіла наша грішна природа. Ми йшли за її бажаннями і за задумами власного розуму. Самою своєю природою ми заслуговували на Божий гнів, так само як і всі інші.

ja.L: その者たちの中で、わたしたちもみな、かつては自分の肉の欲のうちに生き、肉と思いとが望むことを行い、ほかの者たちと同じように、本性によって怒りの子でした。
ja.B: わたしたちもみな、かつてはその者たちの中で生きていました。自分の肉の欲にしたがい、肉と思いの望むままを行っていたのです。わたしたちは本来、ほかの人々と同じように、神の怒りを受けて当然の者でした。
ja.R: わたしたちもみな、以前はそういう人々の中で暮らしていました。わたしたちは、罪に傾く人間の性質が望むことを何でもしていました。その欲と、自分の心の思いのままに生きていたのです。わたしたちは本来、神の怒りを受けて当然の者でした。ほかのすべての人と同じだったのです。

decisions.choice: among whom: among the disobedient people of verse 2
alternatives: in which: in the trespasses of verse 1
decisions.reason: οἷς can be masculine, pointing back to "the sons of disobedience", the nearest people named, or neuter, pointing to παραπτώμασιν. Verse 2 has already said "in which" of the sins, with a different pronoun (αἷς); here Paul says "we also" lived among the disobedient. Either way the point is the same: "we" shared that life.

decisions.choice: we all: Paul and his fellow Jewish believers, and with them all believers
decisions.reason: Paul turns from "you" (Gentile readers, verses 1-2) to "we". The emphatic ἡμεῖς πάντες ("we all") puts Jews and Gentiles in the same place: no one was an exception (Romans 3:9, 3:22-23). The same "we" continues into verses 4-7.

decisions.choice: flesh: human nature turned away from God; the thoughts: the mind's own impulses
decisions.reason: σαρκὸς here is not the body as such but human life lived apart from God, with its desires (Galatians 5:16-21; Romans 8:5-8). διανοιῶν (plural, "thoughts") shows that the mind took part as well: not only bodily appetites but intentions and plans.

decisions.choice: children of wrath: people who deserve God's wrath and are under it
alternatives: people who are angry by temperament
decisions.reason: "Children of" something is a Hebrew way of speaking, like "sons of disobedience" in verse 2; in 1 Samuel 20:31 a "son of death" is a man who deserves to die. ὀργῆς is God's settled judgment against evil (5:6; Romans 1:18; Colossians 3:6), not a human mood.

decisions.choice: by nature: in what they were in themselves, not only in what they had done
decisions.reason: φύσει means by nature, as a thing is in itself (Galatians 2:15; 4:8). Paul says that apart from God's grace this was simply their condition. He does not say here when or how it began; Romans 5:12-19 is the place where he traces it back to Adam.

decisions.choice: the rest: the rest of humanity
decisions.reason: οἱ λοιποί are everyone else: Jews were in the same condition as Gentiles.

decisions.choice: we deserved God's wrath (B); we deserved God's anger (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means (m4) and name God, whose wrath it is. Readable says "anger" as Colossians 3:6 does, a plainer word.

decisions.choice: our sinful nature
decisions.reason: Readable says what "flesh" means here (m3).

decisions.choice: la ira de Dios
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "anger" for a plainer word. Spanish "ira" is already an everyday word, so Spanish keeps the settled term at every level.

decisions.choice: utu wetu wa dhambi (our sinful self)
decisions.reason: Here "flesh" is human nature turned from God, not the body (m3), so Balanced and Readable do not say "mwili", which a reader would take as bodily appetite only. "Asili ya dhambi" (sinful nature) is the usual phrase, but the same verse says "kwa asili" (by nature) for φύσει, and using "asili" for both Greek words would blur them. Literal keeps "mwili".

decisions.choice: la chair (L, B); notre nature pécheresse (R)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 2:11-13, "chair" is kept at Literal and Balanced for human nature turned away from God (m3), so that the word can be followed; Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: "육신" (L, B); "죄에 끌리는 본성" (R), for the flesh as human nature turned away from God, through the letter
decisions.reason: As in Romans and Galatians: Literal and Balanced keep "육신"; Readable says what it means here (the meaning decision), as the English Readable says "our sinful nature".

decisions.choice: "진노의 자녀" (L); "하나님의 진노를 받아 마땅한 사람들" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Children of wrath" is a Hebrew way of saying people under God's wrath (the meaning decision). Literal keeps the phrase; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does. The English has no gender span here, and "자녀" needs none.

decisions.choice: "xác thịt" (L, B); "bản tính tội lỗi" (R) where flesh is human nature turned from God (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: "Xác thịt" is the word kept for sarx in the Vietnamese Colossians and Romans; here it is human nature turned from God (m3), so Readable says "bản tính tội lỗi", as the Vietnamese Romans does at Readable (7:5). Where flesh is only the body or human descent (2:11; 6:5), Readable says so.

decisions.choice: "con cái của cơn thịnh nộ" (L); "đáng chịu cơn thịnh nộ của Đức Chúa Trời" (B); "đáng chịu cơn giận" (R)
decisions.reason: "Cơn thịnh nộ" is the word the Vietnamese Colossians (3:6) and Romans (1:18) keep for God's wrath, with "cơn giận" at Readable. Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom "children of"; Balanced says what it means (m4).

decisions.choice: "chúng ta" for "we all"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision takes in all believers with Paul and his fellow Jews (m2), so the inclusive "chúng ta", which joins the "you" of verses 1-2 to Paul.

decisions.choice: a ira (every level)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as in Romans 1:18. The English Readable says "anger" because "wrath" is rare in English; Portuguese "ira" is still a known word for God's settled judgment (m4), while "raiva" suggests a fit of temper. The same in 5:6.

decisions.choice: a nossa natureza pecadora
decisions.reason: As in Romans 7-8: Readable says what "flesh" means here (m3), as the English Readable does; Literal and Balanced keep "a carne" (docs/portuguese-style.md section 6).

decisions.choice: ሥጋ (flesh, L, B); ኃጢአተኛ ተፈጥሮ (sinful nature, R)
decisions.reason: As in Romans, "ሥጋ" is kept for Paul's word flesh at Literal and Balanced, so a reader can follow it through the letter. Readable says what it means here, human nature turned away from God (meaning decision m3), because "ሥጋ" alone would be heard as the body or as meat.

decisions.choice: "शरीर" (L, B); "शारीरिक स्वभाव" (R)
decisions.reason: Flesh in its moral sense, human nature turned away from God (meaning decision m3): the key term of Romans and Galatians, "शारीरिक स्वभाव" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "क्रोध की सन्तान" (L); "परमेश्वर के क्रोध के योग्य" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means (meaning decision m4) and name God, as the English does. "सन्तान" in Literal is already inclusive.

decisions.choice: плоть (L, B); греховная природа (R)
decisions.reason: Key term as in Romans and Galatians: flesh in its moral sense (m3) is "греховная природа" at Readable.

decisions.choice: тіло (L, B); грішна природа (R)
decisions.reason: Where *sarx* is human nature turned from God, Literal and Balanced keep "тіло" and Readable says what is meant; "плоть" is Church Slavonic. So through the letter.

decisions.choice: "肉" (L, B); "罪に傾く人間の性質" (R)
decisions.reason: Paul's moral sense of flesh: human life turned away from God (m3). The brief keeps the church word at Literal and Balanced and says what it means at Readable. 肉体 would make it the body only.

decisions.choice: "神の怒りを受けて当然の者" (B, R); Literal keeps "怒りの子"
decisions.reason: "Children of wrath" is a Hebrew idiom for people who deserve God's judgment (m4); Balanced and Readable say so and name God, as the English does.

source.text: ὁ δὲ θεὸς πλούσιος ὢν ἐν ἐλέει, διὰ τὴν πολλὴν ἀγάπην αὐτοῦ ἣν ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς, καὶ ὄντας ἡμᾶς νεκροὺς τοῖς παραπτώμασιν συνεζωοποίησεν τῷ Χριστῷ χάριτί ἐστε σεσῳσμένοι καὶ συνήγειρεν καὶ συνεκάθισεν ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ, ἵνα ἐνδείξηται ἐν τοῖς αἰῶσιν τοῖς ἐπερχομένοις τὸ ὑπερβάλλον πλοῦτος τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ ἐν χρηστότητι ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: But God rich being in mercy, because of the great love of him [with] which he loved us, \v 5 even being us dead in the trespasses, made alive together with the Christ — by grace you are saved — \v 6 and raised [us] together and seated [us] together in the heavenly [places] in Christ Jesus, \v 7 so that he might show in the ages the coming the surpassing riches of the grace of him in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus.

en.L: But God, being rich in mercy, because of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great love with which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} loved us, \v 5 even when we were dead in trespasses, made [us] alive together with the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (by grace you have been saved), \v 6 and raised [us] together and seated [us] together in the heavenly [places] in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus, \v 7 in order that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} might display in the ages that are coming the surpassing wealth of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace in kindness toward us in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus.
en.B: But God is rich in mercy. Because of the great love {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had for us, \v 5 even when we were dead in our trespasses, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made us alive together with {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. You have been saved by grace. \v 6 With {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} God raised us up, and with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} seated us in the heavenly places, in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus, \v 7 so that through the ages still to come {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} might put on display the wealth of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace, which surpasses all measure, seen in the kindness {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has shown us in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus.
en.R: But God's mercy is very great, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} loves us with a great love. \v 5 So even when we were spiritually dead because of our sins, God gave us life together with {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. It is by God's grace that you have been saved! \v 6 God raised us up to life with {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, and gave us a place with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in heaven, because we belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus. \v 7 God did this so that for all time to come {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} could show how very rich {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace is. He shows it by being kind to us in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus.

es.L: Pero Dios, siendo rico en misericordia, a causa de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran amor con el cual nos amó, \v 5 aun estando nosotros muertos en los delitos, [nos] vivificó juntamente con el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} (por gracia {{plural_you:han|habéis}} sido salvados), \v 6 y [nos] resucitó juntamente y [nos] sentó juntamente en los [lugares] celestiales en {{christos:Cristo Jesús|Mesías Jesús}}, \v 7 a fin de mostrar en las edades que vienen la riqueza sobreabundante de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia en bondad hacia nosotros en {{christos:Cristo Jesús|Mesías Jesús}}.
es.B: Pero Dios es rico en misericordia. Por el gran amor que nos tuvo, \v 5 aun cuando estábamos muertos en nuestros delitos, nos dio vida juntamente con {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}. Por gracia {{plural_you:ustedes han|vosotros habéis}} sido salvados. \v 6 Con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} Dios nos resucitó, y con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nos sentó en los lugares celestiales, en {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}}, \v 7 para exhibir en las edades que aún han de venir la riqueza de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia, que sobrepasa toda medida, manifestada en la bondad que nos ha mostrado en {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}}.
es.R: Pero la misericordia de Dios es muy grande, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nos ama con un gran amor. \v 5 Por eso, aun cuando estábamos muertos espiritualmente a causa de nuestros pecados, Dios nos dio vida junto con {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}. ¡Es por la gracia de Dios que {{plural_you:ustedes han|vosotros habéis}} sido salvados! \v 6 Dios nos levantó a la vida con {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} y nos dio un lugar con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en el cielo, porque pertenecemos {{christos:a Cristo Jesús|al Mesías Jesús}}. \v 7 Dios hizo esto para mostrar, por todos los tiempos que vendrán, lo inmensamente rica que es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia. Y la muestra al ser bondadoso con nosotros en {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}}.

sw.L: Lakini Mungu, akiwa tajiri wa rehema, kwa sababu ya upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwingi ambao alitupenda nao, \v 5 hata tulipokuwa wafu katika makosa, alitufanya kuwa hai pamoja na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} (kwa neema mmeokolewa), \v 6 akatufufua pamoja [naye], akatuketisha pamoja [naye] katika [ulimwengu wa] mbinguni ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, \v 7 ili aonyeshe katika nyakati zinazokuja utajiri unaozidi mno wa neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} katika wema kwetu ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu.
sw.B: Lakini Mungu ni tajiri wa rehema. Kwa sababu ya upendo mkuu aliokuwa nao kwetu, \v 5 hata tulipokuwa wafu katika makosa yetu, alitufanya kuwa hai pamoja na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Mmeokolewa kwa neema. \v 6 Mungu alitufufua pamoja naye, na pamoja naye akatuketisha katika ulimwengu wa mbinguni, ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, \v 7 ili katika nyakati zote zijazo aonyeshe utajiri wa neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, unaozidi kipimo chochote, unaoonekana katika wema aliotutendea ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu.
sw.R: Lakini rehema ya Mungu ni kubwa sana, naye anatupenda kwa upendo mkuu. \v 5 Kwa hiyo hata tulipokuwa wafu kiroho kwa sababu ya dhambi zetu, Mungu alitupa uzima pamoja na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Ni kwa neema ya Mungu kwamba mmeokolewa! \v 6 Mungu alitufufua tuwe hai pamoja na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, akatupa nafasi pamoja naye mbinguni, kwa sababu sisi ni wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu. \v 7 Mungu alifanya hivyo ili kwa nyakati zote zijazo aonyeshe jinsi neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ilivyo tajiri mno. Anaionyesha kwa kutufanyia wema ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu.

fr.L: Mais Dieu, étant riche en miséricorde, à cause du grand amour dont {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a aimés, \v 5 alors même que nous étions morts dans les fautes, nous a rendus vivants avec le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} (c’est par grâce que vous avez été sauvés), \v 6 et nous a ressuscités ensemble et fait asseoir ensemble dans les [lieux] célestes {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus, \v 7 afin de montrer dans les âges qui viennent l’extraordinaire richesse de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce, dans la bonté envers nous {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus.
fr.B: Mais Dieu est riche en miséricorde. À cause du grand amour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a eu pour nous, \v 5 alors que nous étions morts dans nos fautes, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a rendus vivants avec le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. C’est par grâce que vous avez été sauvés. \v 6 Avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} Dieu nous a ressuscités, et avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} nous a fait asseoir dans les lieux célestes, {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus, \v 7 afin de montrer, dans les âges à venir, la richesse de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce, qui dépasse toute mesure, telle qu’on la voit dans la bonté qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a témoignée {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus.
fr.R: Mais la miséricorde de Dieu est très grande, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous aime d’un grand amour. \v 5 Alors, même quand nous étions morts spirituellement à cause de nos péchés, Dieu nous a donné la vie avec le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. C’est par la grâce de Dieu que vous avez été sauvés ! \v 6 Dieu nous a ressuscités avec le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} pour une vie nouvelle, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a donné une place avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dans le ciel, parce que nous appartenons au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus. \v 7 Dieu l’a fait pour pouvoir montrer, pour toujours, combien {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce est riche. Il la montre en étant bon pour nous {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus.

ko.L: 그러나 긍휼이 풍성하신 하나님께서는 우리를 사랑하신 그분의 큰 사랑 때문에, \v 5 범죄들 가운데서 죽어 있던 우리를 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 함께 살리셨습니다. (여러분은 은혜로 구원을 받았습니다.) \v 6 그리고 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 [우리를] 함께 일으키시고, 하늘에 [속한 곳들]에서 함께 앉히셨습니다. \v 7 이는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 우리에게 베푸신 친절로, 그분의 은혜의 엄청난 풍성함을 오는 세대들에 나타내시려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 그러나 하나님께서는 긍휼이 풍성하신 분입니다. 우리를 사랑하신 그분의 큰 사랑 때문에, \v 5 우리가 범죄 가운데서 죽어 있었을 때에도 하나님께서는 우리를 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 함께 살리셨습니다. 여러분은 은혜로 구원을 받았습니다. \v 6 하나님께서는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 우리를 그분과 함께 일으키시고, 그분과 함께 하늘에 앉히셨습니다. \v 7 그것은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 우리에게 베푸신 친절을 통해, 헤아릴 수 없이 풍성한 그분의 은혜를 앞으로 올 모든 세대에 드러내 보이시려는 것이었습니다.
ko.R: 그러나 하나님의 긍휼은 매우 크시고, 그분은 큰 사랑으로 우리를 사랑하십니다. \v 5 그래서 우리가 죄 때문에 영적으로 죽어 있었을 때에도, 하나님께서는 우리에게 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 함께 생명을 주셨습니다. 여러분이 구원을 받은 것은 하나님의 은혜 덕분입니다! \v 6 하나님께서는 우리를 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 함께 일으켜 살리시고, 하늘에서 그분과 함께 있을 자리를 주셨습니다. 우리가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수께 속해 있기 때문입니다. \v 7 하나님께서 이렇게 하신 것은 그분의 은혜가 얼마나 풍성한지를 앞으로 올 모든 때에 보여 주시려는 것입니다. 하나님께서는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 우리에게 친절을 베푸심으로써 그것을 보여 주십니다.

vi.L: Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời, là Đấng giàu lòng thương xót, vì tình yêu lớn lao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã yêu chúng ta, \v 5 ngay cả khi chúng ta đã chết trong những vi phạm, đã làm cho [chúng ta] sống cùng với {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} (anh chị em đã được cứu là bởi ân điển), \v 6 và đã cho [chúng ta] cùng sống lại và cùng ngồi ở các nơi trên trời trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu, \v 7 để trong các thời đại sắp đến, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tỏ ra sự giàu có vô hạn của ân điển {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} qua lòng nhân từ đối với chúng ta trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu.
vi.B: Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời giàu lòng thương xót. Vì tình yêu lớn lao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dành cho chúng ta, \v 5 ngay cả khi chúng ta đã chết trong những vi phạm, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho chúng ta được sống cùng với {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}. Anh chị em đã được cứu là bởi ân điển. \v 6 Đức Chúa Trời đã cho chúng ta cùng sống lại với Đấng ấy, và cùng ngồi với Đấng ấy ở các nơi trên trời, trong Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, \v 7 để qua các thời đại sắp đến, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bày tỏ sự giàu có của ân điển {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vượt quá mọi sự đo lường, qua lòng nhân từ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dành cho chúng ta trong Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Nhưng lòng thương xót của Đức Chúa Trời thật lớn lao, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} yêu chúng ta bằng một tình yêu lớn lao. \v 5 Vì vậy, ngay cả khi chúng ta đã chết về phần tâm linh vì tội lỗi mình, Đức Chúa Trời đã ban sự sống cho chúng ta cùng với {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}. Chính bởi ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời mà anh chị em đã được cứu! \v 6 Đức Chúa Trời đã cho chúng ta sống lại với {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, và cho chúng ta một chỗ với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở trên trời, vì chúng ta thuộc về Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}. \v 7 Đức Chúa Trời làm điều này để trong mọi thời đại sắp đến, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có thể cho thấy ân điển của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giàu có biết bao. Ngài bày tỏ điều đó bằng cách tỏ lòng nhân từ với chúng ta trong Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.

pt.L: Mas Deus, sendo rico em misericórdia, por causa do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} grande amor com que nos amou, \v 5 mesmo estando nós mortos nas faltas, [nos] deu vida juntamente com o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} (pela graça vocês estão salvos), \v 6 e [nos] ressuscitou juntamente e [nos] fez sentar juntamente nos [lugares] celestiais {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus, \v 7 para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mostrar nas eras que estão vindo a suprema riqueza da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} graça em bondade para conosco {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus.
pt.B: Mas Deus é rico em misericórdia. Por causa do grande amor que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} teve por nós, \v 5 mesmo quando estávamos mortos nas nossas faltas, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos deu vida juntamente com {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}. Vocês foram salvos pela graça. \v 6 Com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} Deus nos ressuscitou, e com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos fez sentar nos lugares celestiais, {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus, \v 7 para mostrar, nas eras que ainda virão, a riqueza da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} graça, que ultrapassa toda medida, vista na bondade que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos mostrou {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus.
pt.R: Mas a misericórdia de Deus é muito grande, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos ama com um grande amor. \v 5 Por isso, mesmo quando estávamos espiritualmente mortos por causa dos nossos pecados, Deus nos deu vida junto com {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}. É pela graça de Deus que vocês foram salvos! \v 6 Deus nos ressuscitou para a vida com {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} e nos deu um lugar com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} no céu, porque pertencemos {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}} Jesus. \v 7 Deus fez isso para mostrar, por todo o tempo que há de vir, como é imensamente rica a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} graça. Ele mostra isso sendo bondoso conosco {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus.

am.L: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር በምሕረት ባለ ጠጋ ሆኖ፣ ከወደደን ከታላቅ ፍቅሩ የተነሣ፣ \v 5 በበደል ሙታን ሳለን እንኳ {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሑ}} ጋር ሕያዋን አደረገን፤ (በጸጋ ድናችኋል)፤ \v 6 አብሮም አስነሣን፤ {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሑ}} ኢየሱስም በሰማያዊ [ስፍራዎች] አብሮ አስቀመጠን፤ \v 7 ይህም በሚመጡት ዘመናት እጅግ የሚበልጠውን የጸጋውን ባለ ጠግነት {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ ለእኛ ባደረገው ቸርነት ያሳይ ዘንድ ነው።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር ግን በምሕረት ባለ ጠጋ ነው። ለእኛ ካለው ከታላቅ ፍቅሩ የተነሣ \v 5 በበደላችን ሙታን ሳለን እንኳ {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሑ}} ጋር ሕያዋን አደረገን። የዳናችሁት በጸጋ ነው። \v 6 እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር አስነሣን፤ {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሑ}} ኢየሱስም ከእርሱ ጋር በሰማያዊ ስፍራዎች አስቀመጠን። \v 7 ይህን ያደረገው በሚመጡት ዘመናት ሁሉ ከመለኪያ በላይ የሆነውን የጸጋውን ባለ ጠግነት እንዲያሳይ ነው፤ ይህም {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ ለእኛ ባሳየው ቸርነት ይታያል።
am.R: ነገር ግን የእግዚአብሔር ምሕረት እጅግ ታላቅ ነው፤ በታላቅ ፍቅርም ይወደናል። \v 5 ስለዚህ በኃጢአታችን ምክንያት በመንፈስ ሙታን ሳለን እንኳ እግዚአብሔር {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሑ}} ጋር ሕይወትን ሰጠን። የዳናችሁት በእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ነው! \v 6 እግዚአብሔር {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሑ}} ጋር ወደ ሕይወት አስነሣን፤ በሰማይም ከእርሱ ጋር ስፍራ ሰጠን፤ ይህም {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ ስለ ሆንን ነው። \v 7 እግዚአብሔር ይህን ያደረገው በሚመጣው ዘመን ሁሉ ጸጋው ምን ያህል ባለ ጠጋ እንደ ሆነ ለማሳየት ነው። ይህንም የሚያሳየው {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ ለእኛ ቸር በመሆኑ ነው።

hi.L: पर परमेश्वर ने, जो दया में धनी हैं, अपने उस बड़े प्रेम के कारण जिससे उन्होंने हमसे प्रेम किया, \v 5 जब हम अपराधों में मरे हुए थे, तब हमें मसीह के साथ जीवित किया (अनुग्रह ही से तुम्हारा उद्धार हुआ है), \v 6 और [हमें] साथ जिला उठाया और मसीह यीशु में स्वर्गीय स्थानों में साथ बैठाया, \v 7 ताकि आनेवाले युगों में वे अपने अनुग्रह का असीम धन, उस कृपा में जो मसीह यीशु में हम पर है, दिखाएँ।
hi.B: पर परमेश्वर दया में धनी हैं। अपने उस बड़े प्रेम के कारण जो उन्होंने हमसे किया, \v 5 जब हम अपने अपराधों में मरे हुए थे, तब भी उन्होंने हमें मसीह के साथ जीवित किया। अनुग्रह ही से तुम्हारा उद्धार हुआ है। \v 6 परमेश्वर ने मसीह के साथ हमें जिला उठाया, और उनके साथ हमें स्वर्गीय स्थानों में बैठाया, मसीह यीशु में, \v 7 ताकि आनेवाले युगों में वे अपने अनुग्रह का वह धन दिखाएँ जो सब सीमाओं से परे है, और जो उस कृपा में दिखाई देता है जो उन्होंने मसीह यीशु में हम पर की है।
hi.R: पर परमेश्वर की दया बहुत बड़ी है, और वे हमसे बड़ा प्रेम करते हैं। \v 5 इसलिए जब हम अपने पापों के कारण आत्मिक रूप से मरे हुए थे, तब भी परमेश्वर ने हमें मसीह के साथ जीवन दिया। परमेश्वर के अनुग्रह ही से तुम्हारा उद्धार हुआ है! \v 6 परमेश्वर ने हमें मसीह के साथ जीवन के लिए जिला उठाया, और उनके साथ हमें स्वर्ग में स्थान दिया, क्योंकि हम मसीह यीशु के हैं। \v 7 परमेश्वर ने यह इसलिए किया कि आनेवाले सारे समय में वे दिखा सकें कि उनका अनुग्रह कितना धनी है। वे इसे मसीह यीशु में हम पर कृपा करके दिखाते हैं।

ru.L: Но Бог, богатый милостью, по своей великой любви, которой {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} возлюбил нас, \v 5 и нас, мёртвых в прегрешениях, оживил вместе {{christos:со Христом|с Мессией}} (благодатью вы спасены), \v 6 и воскресил вместе, и посадил вместе в небесных [местах] {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе, \v 7 чтобы {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} явил в грядущих веках безмерное богатство своей благодати в доброте к нам {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе.
ru.B: Но Бог богат милостью. По великой любви, которую {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} имел к нам, \v 5 даже тогда, когда мы были мертвы из-за своих прегрешений, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} оживил нас вместе с {{christos:Христом|Мессией}}. Вы спасены благодатью. \v 6 С {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} Бог воскресил нас и с {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} посадил нас на небесах, {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе, \v 7 чтобы во все грядущие века {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} мог показать безмерное богатство своей благодати, видимое в доброте, которую {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} проявил к нам {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе.
ru.R: Но Божья милость очень велика, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} любит нас великой любовью. \v 5 Поэтому, даже когда мы были духовно мертвы из-за своих грехов, Бог дал нам жизнь вместе с {{christos:Христом|Мессией}}. Вы спасены именно Божьей благодатью! \v 6 Бог воскресил нас к жизни вместе с {{christos:Христом|Мессией}} и дал нам место рядом с {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} на небе, потому что мы принадлежим {{christos:Христу|Мессии}} Иисусу. \v 7 Бог сделал это, чтобы во все будущие времена {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} мог показывать, как богата {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} благодать. Он показывает это, проявляя к нам доброту {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе.

uk.L: Але Бог, будучи багатим на милосердя, через свою велику любов, якою {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} полюбив нас, \v 5 і нас, які були мертві в провинах, оживив разом із {{christos:Христом|Месією}} (благодаттю ви спасені), \v 6 і разом воскресив [нас], і разом посадив [нас] у небесних [місцях] {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} Ісусі, \v 7 щоб показати в прийдешніх віках безмірне багатство своєї благодаті в доброті до нас {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} Ісусі.
uk.B: Але Бог багатий на милосердя. Через велику любов, якою {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} полюбив нас, \v 5 навіть коли ми були мертві у своїх провинах, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} оживив нас разом із {{christos:Христом|Месією}}. Благодаттю ви спасені. \v 6 Разом із {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} Бог воскресив нас і разом із {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} посадив на небесах, {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} Ісусі, \v 7 щоб у прийдешніх віках показати безмірне багатство своєї благодаті, явлене в доброті, яку {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} виявив до нас {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} Ісусі.
uk.R: Але Боже милосердя дуже велике, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} любить нас великою любовʼю. \v 5 Тому навіть тоді, коли ми були духовно мертві через свої гріхи, Бог дав нам життя разом із {{christos:Христом|Месією}}. Ви спасені саме Божою благодаттю! \v 6 Бог воскресив нас до життя разом із {{christos:Христом|Месією}} і дав нам місце поруч із {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} на небі, бо ми належимо {{christos:Христові|Месії}} Ісусу. \v 7 Бог зробив це, щоб у всі прийдешні часи показувати, яка надзвичайно багата {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} благодать. Він показує її, коли виявляє доброту до нас {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} Ісусі.

ja.L: しかし、あわれみに富んでおられる神は、わたしたちを愛されたその大きな愛のゆえに、\v 5 過ちのうちに死んでいたわたしたちを、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}とともに生かし――あなたがたは恵みによって救われているのです――\v 6 ともによみがえらせ、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスにあって、天上の[場所]にともに座らせてくださいました。\v 7 それは、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスにあってわたしたちに示された慈しみのうちに、ご自分の恵みの測り知れない富を、来たるべき世々に現すためです。
ja.B: しかし、神はあわれみに富んだ方です。わたしたちを愛してくださったその大きな愛のゆえに、\v 5 過ちのうちに死んでいたわたしたちを、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}とともに生かしてくださいました。あなたがたは恵みによって救われたのです。\v 6 神は、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスに結ばれたわたしたちを、この方とともによみがえらせ、この方とともに天上に座らせてくださいました。\v 7 それは、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスに結ばれたわたしたちへの慈しみによって、測り知れないほど豊かな恵みを、これから来るすべての時代に示すためでした。
ja.R: しかし、神のあわれみはとても大きく、神は大きな愛でわたしたちを愛してくださっています。\v 5 ですから、わたしたちが自分のした悪いことのために霊的に死んでいたときにも、神はわたしたちに、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}とともに命を与えてくださいました。みなさんが救われたのは、神の恵みによるのです。\v 6 神は、わたしたちを{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}とともによみがえらせ、天でこの方とともにいる場所を与えてくださいました。わたしたちが{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスと一つにされているからです。\v 7 神がこうなさったのは、ご自分の恵みがどれほど豊かであるかを、これから先いつまでも示すためです。神は、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスと一つにされたわたしたちに親切にしてくださることで、それを示されるのです。

decisions.choice: Paul takes up the sentence he broke off in verse 1: God is the subject, and "made alive" is its main verb
decisions.reason: ὁ δὲ θεὸς ("but God") answers the "you" of verse 1, and verse 5 repeats "being dead in trespasses" from verse 1, now with "us". The three verbs that follow say what God has done.

decisions.choice: rich in mercy, out of great love: the reason for God's action lies in God, not in those he saved
decisions.reason: ἐλέει is pity that acts to help, and ἀγάπην ... ἠγάπησεν ("the love with which he loved") doubles the word for love. Paul gives no reason in the people themselves: they were dead (verse 5).

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "made us alive together with Christ"
decisions.reason: A few early manuscripts add ἐν ("in") before τῷ Χριστῷ, giving "in Christ", perhaps to match "in Christ Jesus" in verses 6-7. The SBLGNT follows the reading without it, where the dative goes with the "together" of the verb: alive together with Christ. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: by grace you have been saved: a short cry that breaks into the sentence, saying that their salvation is already done and still stands
decisions.reason: The perfect σεσῳσμένοι says the saving happened and its result remains. Paul breaks his sentence to say it, and turns from "us" back to "you". He comes back to the words in verse 8 and explains them.

decisions.choice: made alive with, raised with, seated with: what God did for Christ, God has done for believers joined to him
alternatives: Jews and Gentiles made alive together, with each other
decisions.reason: συνεζωοποίησεν, συνήγειρεν and συνεκάθισεν all begin with a prefix meaning "together with". God raised Christ from the dead and seated him in the heavenly places (1:20); now Paul says the same of believers, in Christ. He speaks of it as already done, because they are joined to Christ, though they still wait for its full outcome (1:14; Colossians 3:1-4). The first verb names Christ as the one they are joined with.

decisions.choice: the heavenly places: the heavenly realm where Christ now reigns
decisions.reason: As in 1:3 and 1:20, ἐπουρανίοις is the heavenly realm. Here it is the place where Christ sits at God's right hand (1:20), and believers are said to share his place there.

decisions.choice: the coming ages: all time to come, without end
alternatives: the generations still to come in this world's history
decisions.reason: αἰῶσιν τοῖς ἐπερχομένοις ("the ages coming") looks forward to all the future, as "this age and the one to come" does in 1:21. God's kindness to them will be on show for ever.

decisions.choice: in kindness toward us: the way God displays the wealth of his grace
decisions.reason: ἐν χρηστότητι says how the grace is seen: in God's kindness to people like those of verses 1-3, who deserved wrath.

decisions.choice: You have been saved by grace. (B); It is by God's grace that you have been saved! (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make Paul's interjection (m4) its own short sentence, so that the long sentence can be read aloud.

decisions.choice: With {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} God raised us up, and with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} seated us (B); God raised us up to life with {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, and gave us a place with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God as the subject and say who the "together" is with (m5).

decisions.choice: in heaven
decisions.reason: As in the rest of Ephesians at this level, Readable uses the plain word (m6).

decisions.choice: because we belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable says what "in Christ Jesus" means here: these things are true of believers because they are joined to Christ (m5).

decisions.choice: spiritually dead because of our sins
decisions.reason: As in verse 1.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans only on written pronouns
decisions.reason: Spanish usually leaves the subject inside the verb ("nos amó", "nos sentó"), so the setting applies only where a pronoun is written ("su gracia", "con él"). The Spanish therefore has fewer pronoun spans than the English.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans only on free pronouns and possessives
decisions.reason: Swahili marks the subject and object inside the verb (alitupenda, akatufufua) and joins "na" and "yeye" into "naye"; none of these can take a capital. The setting applies to free possessives such as "upendo wake" and "neema yake", so the Swahili has fewer spans than the English.

decisions.choice: ulimwengu wa mbinguni (L, B); mbinguni (R)
decisions.reason: Here the heavenly places are where Christ sits at God's right hand (m6), so Swahili names heaven itself rather than "ulimwengu wa roho" (the spirit world), which would also suit the realm of the evil powers in 6:12. Literal brackets "ulimwengu wa", which the Greek lacks.

decisions.choice: vous avez été sauvés (every level, here and in 2:8)
decisions.reason: The Greek perfect says that the rescue has happened and its result stands (m4). "Vous êtes sauvés" would stress only the present state; "vous avez été sauvés" names the act, and in French its result is still understood.

decisions.choice: "(여러분은 은혜로 구원을 받았습니다.)" set in parentheses (L)
alternatives: the cry run into the sentence
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says the words break into the sentence. Korean cannot put a full sentence inside a verb-final clause, so Literal sets it apart in parentheses; Balanced and Readable give it as its own sentence, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "긍휼" for mercy at every level
decisions.reason: As in Galatians 6:16: "긍휼" is the established word for God's mercy and is still understood.

decisions.choice: "đã được cứu" for the perfect "you have been saved" (here and in 2:8)
decisions.reason: The salvation is already done and still stands (m4). "Đã được cứu" says that it has happened; the passive needs no word for who saves, as the Greek gives none, and the context names God.

decisions.choice: "với Đấng ấy" (B) for "together"
decisions.reason: The Greek verbs say "raised with" and "seated with" Christ (m5); Vietnamese "cùng nhau" would be heard as "with one another", so Balanced names Christ, as the English says "with him".

decisions.choice: vocês estão salvos (L); vocês foram salvos (B, R)
decisions.reason: The perfect says that the saving happened and its result remains (m4). Literal says "estão salvos", the present state; Balanced and Readable say "foram salvos", the finished act. "Têm sido salvos" would mean in Portuguese something repeated again and again. The same in verse 8.

decisions.choice: ድናችኋል (L); የዳናችሁት ... ነው (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek perfect says that their salvation is done and still stands (meaning decision m4). The Amharic present perfect "ድናችኋል" carries exactly that; Balanced and Readable use the cleft "የዳናችሁት በጸጋ ነው" to put the weight on grace, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "मसीह" with no christos setting
decisions.reason: "मसीह" is both the familiar name and the word Messiah itself, so the choice the English setting offers is already made (style guide, section 7). The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans; honorific forms for God and Christ ("उन्होंने", "वे")
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi. Respect for God and Christ comes from the honorific third person at every level (style guide, sections 4 and 7). The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: "अनुग्रह ही से तुम्हारा उद्धार हुआ है"
decisions.reason: "उद्धार" is the established word for salvation, and the perfect "हुआ है" says that it is done and still stands (meaning decision m4). The same in verse 8.

decisions.choice: "जीवित किया" (verse 5) ... "जिला उठाया" (verse 6)
decisions.reason: Two Greek verbs, made alive and raised up (meaning decision m5); Hindi keeps two verbs so the three steps stay distinct.

decisions.choice: своей любви, своей благодати, without a setting
decisions.reason: With God as the subject Russian uses the reflexive "свой", which takes no pronoun setting; other pronouns for God carry it, as in the English.

decisions.choice: вместе {{christos:со Христом|с Мессией}}
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the traditional "со Христом", so the preposition goes inside each option.

decisions.choice: "――あなたがたは恵みによって救われているのです――" (L)
decisions.reason: Paul breaks into his sentence with a short cry (m4). Literal sets it off with dashes inside the sentence, as the Greek does; Balanced and Readable make it its own sentence, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "慈しみ" (L, B); "親切にしてくださる" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is kindness shown to those who deserved wrath (m8). 慈しみ is the warm, written word; Readable uses the everyday 親切.

decisions.choice: "this" is the whole of what Paul has just said: being saved by grace through faith
decisions.reason: τοῦτο is neuter, while χάριτί and πίστεως are both feminine. Paul often uses a neuter "this" for a whole statement rather than one word (Philippians 1:28). What follows fits salvation as a whole: it is "not from you", it is God's gift, and it is "not from works" (verse 9), which could not be said of faith on its own. Faith is part of what is given, but Paul's point is that the whole of salvation, from first to last, comes from God.

decisions.choice: by the grace: the grace just spoken of in verses 5 and 7
decisions.reason: τῇ has the article, pointing back to the grace of verse 5 ("by grace you have been saved") and the wealth of grace in verse 7. γὰρ ("for") explains why God's kindness will be on show: everything about their salvation is grace.

decisions.choice: through faith: faith is the way salvation is received, not its cause
decisions.reason: χάριτί (dative, "by grace") is the source of salvation; διὰ πίστεως ("through faith") is the channel by which it reaches people. Faith is trust in God and in Christ (1:13, 1:15).

decisions.choice: gift: something given freely, not earned
decisions.reason: δῶρον is a present. θεοῦ comes first in its clause for emphasis: God's is the gift, set against ἐξ ὑμῶν ("from you").

decisions.choice: None of this comes from you
decisions.reason: "This" after "through faith" would be read as "faith". "None of this" points to the whole statement, as the Greek does (m1); Literal keeps "this".

decisions.choice: Being saved does not come from you
decisions.reason: Readable says what "this" refers to (m1).

decisions.choice: by this grace
decisions.reason: Balanced shows that the article points back to the grace of verses 5-7 (m2).

decisions.choice: esto (neuter)
decisions.reason: Spanish has a neuter demonstrative, as Greek does here. "Esto" points to the whole statement, being saved by grace through faith (m1); "esta" would point to "la fe" or "la gracia" alone.

decisions.choice: hili / jambo hili
decisions.reason: "Hii" would agree with "neema" or "imani" (both class 9) and point to one of them. "Hili", the class 5 form used for a matter or affair ("jambo hili"), points to the whole statement, as the Greek neuter does (m1).

decisions.choice: Rien de cela (B)
decisions.reason: As in English: "cela" right after "par la foi" would be read as the faith alone; "rien de cela" points to the whole of being saved by grace through faith (m1). Literal keeps the plain "cela".

decisions.choice: "구원" for salvation and "구원을 받다" for "be saved", at every level, through the letter
decisions.reason: The key term takes "구원", the Korean church word for being saved, which is plain enough for Readable.

decisions.choice: "món quà" for the gift
decisions.reason: The word is the plain word for a gift given freely (m4). The Vietnamese Romans keeps "ân tứ" for a different Greek word, the gift of grace (5:15; 6:23), so the plain "món quà" is used here.

decisions.choice: "điều đó" (L), "không điều gì trong đó" (B), "được cứu" (R) for "this"
decisions.reason: "This" is the whole of being saved by grace through faith (m1), not faith alone, so Vietnamese uses the neutral "điều đó" and does not tie it to one noun.

decisions.choice: "इसमें से कुछ भी" (B); "उद्धार पाना" (R)
decisions.reason: "This" is the whole of being saved by grace through faith (meaning decision m1); a bare "यह" after "विश्वास" would be read as faith alone, so Balanced and Readable say what it points to.

decisions.choice: благодать; вера
decisions.reason: Key terms of Paul's letters, the same at every level.

decisions.choice: "これ" (L); "このすべて" (B); "救われること" (R)
decisions.reason: "This" is the whole of being saved by grace through faith (m1). Right after 信仰, Japanese これ could be read as faith alone; Balanced says このすべて and Readable names salvation, as the English does. Literal keeps これ.

ja.L: 行いから[出たの]ではありません。だれも誇ることがないためです。
ja.B: それは、人がしたことの結果ではありません。ですから、だれも誇ることはできません。
ja.R: 自分のしたことで救いを手に入れる人は、だれもいません。だから、だれもそれを自慢できません。

decisions.choice: "not from works" completes verse 8: it says again where salvation does not come from
decisions.reason: οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων matches οὐκ ἐξ ὑμῶν ("not from you") in verse 8. The SBLGNT ends verse 8 with a raised dot, so verse 9 stands as its own record, but it has no verb and continues the same thought.

decisions.choice: works: anything people do that might be thought to earn God's favor
alternatives: only the works required by the law of Moses
decisions.reason: Elsewhere Paul speaks of "works of the law" (Galatians 2:16; Romans 3:28). Here ἔργων has no qualifier and is addressed to Gentiles as well as Jews, so it covers human deeds of every kind. Verse 10 shows that good works still matter: they are the result of salvation, not its cause.

decisions.choice: so that no one may boast: God's purpose in saving this way
alternatives: with the result that no one can boast
decisions.reason: ἵνα states purpose: God saves by grace so that no one can take credit before him (1 Corinthians 1:29-31; Romans 3:27). καυχήσηται is boasting in the sense of claiming credit.

decisions.choice: It is not the result of what anyone has done (B); Nobody earns it by the things they do (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the phrase a subject and a verb so it can stand as a sentence (m1), and say what "works" means (m2).

decisions.choice: "khoe mình" (L); "khoe khoang" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Romans (3:27), Literal keeps "khoe mình" for this word family; here the boasting is pride in one's own doing before God, so Balanced and Readable say "khoe khoang", which carries the fault.

decisions.choice: se glorie (L); se orgulhar (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as docs/portuguese-style.md section 6 sets it: "gloriar-se" (L) and "orgulhar-se" (B, R) for claiming credit before God (m3). "Gabar-se" is kept for Readable where the English Readable says "brag".

decisions.choice: "काम"
decisions.reason: As in Romans and Galatians: works are "काम", never "कर्म", which carries the idea of karma.

source.text: αὐτοῦ γάρ ἐσμεν ποίημα, κτισθέντες ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἐπὶ ἔργοις ἀγαθοῖς οἷς προητοίμασεν ὁ θεὸς ἵνα ἐν αὐτοῖς περιπατήσωμεν.

records.literal_gloss: Of him for we are [a] thing made, having been created in Christ Jesus for works good which prepared beforehand the God so that in them we might walk.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} handiwork we are, having been created in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus for good works that God prepared in advance, so that in them we might walk.
en.B: For we are God's own work. In {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} created us for good works, which God made ready in advance so that we would live our lives doing them.
en.R: God is the one who made us what we are. He created us new because we belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus, so that we would do good things. God got these good things ready ahead of time, so that we would live by doing them.

es.L: Porque de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} somos obra, habiendo sido creados en {{christos:Cristo Jesús|Mesías Jesús}} para obras buenas que Dios preparó con anticipación, a fin de que en ellas caminemos.
es.B: Porque somos obra del mismo Dios. En {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}} nos creó para buenas obras, que Dios dispuso de antemano para que vivamos practicándolas.
es.R: Dios es quien nos hizo lo que somos. Nos creó de nuevo porque pertenecemos {{christos:a Cristo Jesús|al Mesías Jesús}}, para que hagamos cosas buenas. Dios preparó esas cosas buenas desde antes, para que vivamos haciéndolas.

sw.L: Kwa maana sisi ni kazi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, tulioumbwa ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu kwa ajili ya matendo mema ambayo Mungu aliyaandaa mapema ili tuenende katika hayo.
sw.B: Kwa maana sisi ni kazi ya Mungu mwenyewe. Ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu alituumba kwa ajili ya matendo mema, ambayo Mungu aliyaandaa mapema ili maisha yetu yawe ya kuyatenda.
sw.R: Mungu ndiye aliyetufanya tulivyo. Alituumba upya kwa sababu sisi ni wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, ili tufanye mambo mema. Mungu aliyaandaa mambo hayo mema tangu zamani, ili tuishi kwa kuyatenda.

fr.L: Car nous sommes {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} ouvrage, ayant été créés {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus pour des œuvres bonnes que Dieu a préparées d’avance afin que nous marchions en elles.
fr.B: Car nous sommes l’ouvrage de Dieu. {{christos:En Christ|Dans le Messie}} Jésus, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a créés pour les œuvres bonnes que Dieu a préparées d’avance, afin que nous passions notre vie à les accomplir.
fr.R: C’est Dieu qui a fait de nous ce que nous sommes. Il nous a créés de nouveau parce que nous appartenons au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus, pour que nous fassions le bien. Dieu a préparé d’avance ce bien à faire, pour que nous vivions en le faisant.

ko.L: 우리는 그분이 만드신 작품입니다. {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 선한 일들을 위하여 창조되었으니, 하나님께서는 그 일들을 미리 준비하셔서 우리가 그 가운데서 걷게 하셨습니다.
ko.B: 우리는 하나님께서 친히 만드신 작품입니다. 하나님께서는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 우리를 선한 일을 하도록 창조하셨습니다. 하나님께서 그 일들을 미리 준비하셔서, 우리가 그 일을 하며 살아가게 하셨습니다.
ko.R: 우리를 지금의 우리로 만드신 분은 하나님이십니다. 하나님께서는 우리가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수께 속하게 하셔서 우리를 새롭게 창조하셨습니다. 우리가 좋은 일을 하게 하시려는 것입니다. 하나님께서는 그 좋은 일들을 미리 준비해 두셨습니다. 우리가 그 일들을 하면서 살게 하시려는 것입니다.

vi.L: Vì chúng ta là công trình của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đã được tạo dựng trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu cho những việc lành mà Đức Chúa Trời đã chuẩn bị trước, để chúng ta bước đi trong đó.
vi.B: Vì chúng ta là công trình của chính Đức Chúa Trời. Trong Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tạo dựng chúng ta để làm những việc lành mà Đức Chúa Trời đã chuẩn bị sẵn từ trước, để chúng ta sống bằng cách làm những việc ấy.
vi.R: Chính Đức Chúa Trời đã làm cho chúng ta trở nên như hiện nay. Ngài đã tạo dựng chúng ta mới lại vì chúng ta thuộc về Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, để chúng ta làm những việc tốt lành. Đức Chúa Trời đã chuẩn bị sẵn những việc tốt ấy từ trước, để chúng ta sống bằng cách làm những việc ấy.

pt.L: Pois {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} somos obra, tendo sido criados {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus para boas obras, que Deus preparou de antemão para que andássemos nelas.
pt.B: Pois somos a própria obra de Deus. {{christos:Em Cristo|No Messias}} Jesus {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos criou para as boas obras, que Deus preparou de antemão para que vivêssemos praticando essas obras.
pt.R: Foi Deus quem nos fez o que somos. Ele nos criou de novo porque pertencemos {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}} Jesus, para que fizéssemos o bem. Deus preparou essas boas ações com antecedência, para que a nossa vida fosse cheia delas.

am.L: እርሱ የሠራን ነንና፤ እግዚአብሔር በእነርሱ እንድንመላለስ አስቀድሞ ላዘጋጃቸው መልካም ሥራዎች {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ ተፈጠርን።
am.B: እኛ የእግዚአብሔር የእጅ ሥራ ነንና። {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ ለመልካም ሥራዎች ፈጠረን፤ እነዚህንም ሥራዎች እየሠራን እንድንኖር እግዚአብሔር አስቀድሞ አዘጋጃቸው።
am.R: አሁን ያለንበትን ማንነት የሰጠን እግዚአብሔር ነው። {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ ስለ ሆንን አዲስ አድርጎ ፈጠረን፤ ይህም መልካም ነገሮችን እንድናደርግ ነው። እግዚአብሔር እነዚህን መልካም ነገሮች አስቀድሞ አዘጋጀ፤ ይህም እነርሱን እያደረግን እንድንኖር ነው።

hi.L: क्योंकि हम उनकी रचना हैं, और मसीह यीशु में उन भले कामों के लिए सृजे गए जिन्हें परमेश्वर ने पहले से तैयार किया, कि हम उनमें चलें।
hi.B: क्योंकि हम परमेश्वर की अपनी रचना हैं। उन्होंने मसीह यीशु में हमें भले कामों के लिए सृजा है, जिन्हें परमेश्वर ने पहले से तैयार किया, ताकि हम उन्हें करते हुए अपना जीवन बिताएँ।
hi.R: परमेश्वर ही ने हमें वैसा बनाया है जैसे हम हैं। क्योंकि हम मसीह यीशु के हैं, इसलिए उन्होंने हमें नया बनाया, ताकि हम अच्छे काम करें। परमेश्वर ने ये अच्छे काम पहले से तैयार कर रखे थे, ताकि हम उन्हें करते हुए जिएँ।

ru.L: Ведь мы — {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} творение, созданные {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе для добрых дел, которые Бог заранее приготовил, чтобы мы в них ходили.
ru.B: Ведь мы — Божье творение. {{christos:Во Христе|В Мессии}} Иисусе {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} создал нас для добрых дел, которые Бог заранее приготовил, чтобы мы жили, совершая их.
ru.R: Это Бог сделал нас такими, какие мы есть. Он создал нас заново, потому что мы принадлежим {{christos:Христу|Мессии}} Иисусу, чтобы мы делали добрые дела. Бог заранее приготовил эти добрые дела, чтобы мы жили, делая их.

uk.L: Бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} творіння ми, створені {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} Ісусі для добрих діл, які Бог наперед приготував, щоб ми в них ходили.
uk.B: Бо ми — Божий твір. {{christos:У Христі|В Месії}} Ісусі {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} створив нас для добрих діл, які Бог наперед приготував, щоб ми жили, чинячи їх.
uk.R: Це Бог зробив нас тими, ким ми є. Він створив нас новими, бо ми належимо {{christos:Христові|Месії}} Ісусу, щоб ми робили добро. Бог заздалегідь приготував ці добрі справи, щоб ми жили, роблячи їх.

ja.L: というのは、わたしたちは[神]の造られたものであって、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスにあって良い行いのために造られたからです。その良い行いを神はあらかじめ備えて、わたしたちがその中を歩むようにされたのです。
ja.B: わたしたちは、神ご自身が造られたものなのです。神は、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスに結ばれた者として、わたしたちを良い行いのために造ってくださいました。その良い行いを、神は前もって備えてくださいました。わたしたちがそれを行いながら生きるためです。
ja.R: わたしたちを今のようなわたしたちにしてくださったのは、神です。わたしたちが{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスと一つにされたので、神はわたしたちを新しく造ってくださいました。わたしたちが良いことをするためです。神はその良いことを前もって用意しておいてくださいました。わたしたちがそれを行って生きるためです。

decisions.choice: a thing made: what God has made, here his new creation in Christ
alternatives: a masterpiece or work of art
decisions.reason: ποίημα is the ordinary word for something made, used of God's works in creation (Romans 1:20). The word "poem" comes from it, but in the Greek of the time it does not itself mean a work of art. The next word, κτισθέντες ("created"), shows what kind of making Paul means.

decisions.choice: his work: God's doing, not ours
decisions.reason: αὐτοῦ stands first for emphasis, and γάρ ("for") ties the verse to verses 8-9: salvation is not from works, because we ourselves are God's work. The "his" is God, named as the giver in verse 8 and as the one who prepared the works in this verse.

decisions.choice: created in Christ Jesus: made new by being joined to Christ
