ru.R: Благодаря тому, что сделал {{christos:Христос|Мессия}}, все мы, иудеи и люди других народов, можем вместе прийти к Богу Отцу через одного Духа.

uk.L: бо через {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} ми маємо доступ, обидві [сторони], в одному Дусі до Отця.
uk.B: Саме через {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} і ті, і другі з нас можуть приступати до Отця в одному Дусі.
uk.R: Завдяки тому, що зробив {{christos:Христос|Месія}}, усі ми, юдеї і неюдеї, можемо разом приходити до Бога Отця через одного Духа.

ja.L: というのは、その方を通して、わたしたち両者は一つの霊において父に近づく道を得ているからです。
ja.B: この方を通して、わたしたち両者は、同じ一つの霊によって父に近づくことができるのです。
ja.R: {{christos:キリスト|メシア}}がしてくださったことのおかげで、ユダヤ人もそうでない人も、わたしたちはみな、同じ一つの聖霊によって、ともに父である神のもとに行くことができるのです。

decisions.choice: because: this is why it is peace
decisions.reason: ὅτι gives the reason the message of verse 17 is peace: both groups now have access to the Father.

decisions.choice: access: the right to come into someone's presence
decisions.reason: προσαγωγὴν is the act or right of approaching, used of being brought before a king and of approaching God in worship (Romans 5:2; Ephesians 3:12). Gentiles once kept out of the inner temple courts, and Jews too, now come to God himself.

decisions.choice: in one Spirit: by God's Holy Spirit, the same Spirit for both
alternatives: in one spirit: with a shared attitude
decisions.reason: πνεύματι here is God's Spirit, by whom believers were sealed (1:13) and in whom God lives among them (verse 22); 4:4 speaks of "one body and one Spirit". The verse names Christ, the Spirit and the Father together: through Christ, in the Spirit, to the Father.

decisions.choice: both of us (B); all of us, Jews and Gentiles (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear that "both" are the two groups of verses 14-17.

decisions.choice: Because of what {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} has done
decisions.reason: Readable names Christ and says how the access comes through him.

decisions.choice: kibali cha kukaribia
decisions.reason: προσαγωγὴν is the right to come into someone's presence (m2). "Kibali" (leave, permission) keeps the sense of being admitted, as before a king; "ufikiaji" is a technical word for access. Balanced and Readable use the verbs "kumwendea" and "kumjia" (come to him).

decisions.choice: "được đến gần" (L), "có thể đến gần" (B), "có thể ... đến với" (R) for access
decisions.reason: The noun is the right to come into someone's presence (m2), which Vietnamese says with a verb, as the Vietnamese Romans does (5:2, "được dẫn vào"). "Chúng ta" joins the two groups.

decisions.choice: "近づく道" (L); "近づくことができる" (B); "もとに行くことができる" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is the right to come into someone's presence (m2). Japanese has no single noun for it that reads naturally; Literal keeps a noun, Balanced and Readable say it with a verb of coming near.

source.text: ἄρα οὖν οὐκέτι ἐστὲ ξένοι καὶ πάροικοι, ἀλλὰ ἐστὲ συμπολῖται τῶν ἁγίων καὶ οἰκεῖοι τοῦ θεοῦ, ἐποικοδομηθέντες ἐπὶ τῷ θεμελίῳ τῶν ἀποστόλων καὶ προφητῶν, ὄντος ἀκρογωνιαίου αὐτοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ, ἐν ᾧ πᾶσα οἰκοδομὴ συναρμολογουμένη αὔξει εἰς ναὸν ἅγιον ἐν κυρίῳ, ἐν ᾧ καὶ ὑμεῖς συνοικοδομεῖσθε εἰς κατοικητήριον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν πνεύματι.

records.literal_gloss: So then no longer are you strangers and resident aliens, but you are fellow citizens of the holy [ones] and household members of the God, \v 20 having been built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, being cornerstone himself Christ Jesus, \v 21 in whom every building being fitted together grows into temple holy in [the] Lord, \v 22 in whom also you are being built together into dwelling place of the God in [the] Spirit.

en.L: So then no longer are you strangers and resident aliens, but you are fellow citizens of the holy ones and household members of God, \v 20 having been built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, the cornerstone being {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, \v 21 in whom every building, being joined together, grows into a holy temple in [the] Lord, \v 22 in whom you also are being built up together into a dwelling of God in [the] Spirit.
en.B: So you are no longer strangers and resident foreigners. You are citizens together with God's holy people, and you belong to God's household. \v 20 You have been built on the apostles and prophets as your foundation, and the cornerstone is {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}. \v 21 In {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} all the building, as it is fitted together, is growing into a holy temple in the Lord. \v 22 And in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} you also are being built up with the others into a home for God, who lives there by the Spirit.
en.R: So now you are not strangers or outsiders anymore. You are citizens together with all of God's people, and you are part of God's family. \v 20 You are like a building that God is putting up. The apostles and prophets are its foundation, and {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} is the cornerstone. \v 21 In {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the whole building is fitted together, and it is growing into a holy temple, joined to the Lord. \v 22 And in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} you too are being built together with the others into a home where God lives by the Spirit.

es.L: Así pues, ya no {{plural_you:son|sois}} extranjeros y forasteros, sino que {{plural_you:son|sois}} conciudadanos de los santos y familiares de Dios, \v 20 edificados sobre el fundamento de los apóstoles y profetas, siendo la piedra angular el mismo {{christos:Cristo Jesús|Mesías Jesús}}, \v 21 en quien todo edificio, siendo ensamblado, crece hasta ser un templo santo en [el] Señor, \v 22 en quien también {{plural_you:ustedes son|vosotros sois}} edificados juntamente para ser morada de Dios en [el] Espíritu.
es.B: Así que ya no {{plural_you:son|sois}} extranjeros ni residentes sin ciudadanía. {{plural_you:Son|Sois}} ciudadanos junto con el pueblo santo de Dios, y {{plural_you:pertenecen|pertenecéis}} a la familia de Dios. \v 20 {{plural_you:Han|Habéis}} sido edificados sobre los apóstoles y los profetas como fundamento, y la piedra angular es {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}} mismo. \v 21 En {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} todo el edificio, bien ensamblado, va creciendo hasta ser un templo santo en el Señor. \v 22 Y en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} también {{plural_you:ustedes son|vosotros sois}} edificados junto con los demás para ser un hogar para Dios, que vive allí por el Espíritu.
es.R: Así que ahora ya no {{plural_you:son|sois}} extraños ni gente de afuera. {{plural_you:Son|Sois}} ciudadanos junto con todo el pueblo de Dios, y {{plural_you:son|sois}} parte de la familia de Dios. \v 20 {{plural_you:Son|Sois}} como un edificio que Dios está levantando. Los apóstoles y los profetas son su fundamento, y {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}} mismo es la piedra angular. \v 21 En {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} todo el edificio está bien unido, y va creciendo hasta ser un templo santo, unido al Señor. \v 22 Y en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} también {{plural_you:ustedes están|vosotros estáis}} siendo construidos junto con los demás para ser un hogar donde Dios vive por el Espíritu.

sw.L: Basi kwa hiyo ninyi si wageni tena wala wakazi wasio raia, bali ni raia wenzi wa watakatifu na wanafamilia wa Mungu, \v 20 mkiwa mmejengwa juu ya msingi wa mitume na wa manabii, jiwe la pembeni likiwa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, \v 21 ambaye ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kila jengo, likiungwa pamoja, linaongezeka kuwa hekalu takatifu ndani ya Bwana, \v 22 ambaye ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ninyi pia mnajengwa pamoja kuwa makao ya Mungu katika Roho.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo ninyi si wageni tena wala wakazi wasio na haki za raia. Mmekuwa raia pamoja na watu wa Mungu walio watakatifu, na ninyi ni wa nyumba ya Mungu. \v 20 Mmejengwa juu ya mitume na manabii kama msingi wenu, na jiwe la pembeni ni {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}. \v 21 Ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} jengo zima linaunganishwa sehemu kwa sehemu, nalo linakua hadi kuwa hekalu takatifu ndani ya Bwana. \v 22 Nanyi pia, ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, mnajengwa pamoja na wengine kuwa nyumba ya Mungu, anayekaa humo kwa Roho.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo sasa ninyi si wageni wala watu wa nje tena. Ninyi ni raia pamoja na watu wote wa Mungu, na ni sehemu ya familia ya Mungu. \v 20 Mko kama jengo ambalo Mungu analijenga. Mitume na manabii ndio msingi wake, na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} ndiye jiwe la pembeni. \v 21 Ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} jengo lote limeunganishwa vizuri, nalo linakua kuwa hekalu takatifu, lililounganishwa na Bwana. \v 22 Nanyi pia, ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, mnajengwa pamoja na wengine kuwa nyumba ambamo Mungu anakaa kwa Roho.

fr.L: Ainsi donc vous n’êtes plus des étrangers et des résidents sans droits, mais vous êtes concitoyens des saints et membres de la maison de Dieu, \v 20 ayant été édifiés sur le fondement des apôtres et des prophètes, la pierre angulaire étant le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}, \v 21 en qui toute construction, bien ajustée, s’élève pour [être] un temple saint dans le Seigneur, \v 22 en qui vous aussi, vous êtes édifiés ensemble pour [être] une demeure de Dieu dans l’Esprit.
fr.B: Ainsi, vous n’êtes plus des étrangers ni des résidents sans droit de cité. Vous êtes concitoyens du peuple saint de Dieu, et vous appartenez à la maison de Dieu. \v 20 Vous avez été bâtis sur les apôtres et les prophètes, qui sont vos fondations, et la pierre angulaire, c’est le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}. \v 21 En {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, tout l’édifice, dont les parties s’ajustent les unes aux autres, s’élève pour devenir un temple saint dans le Seigneur. \v 22 Et en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, vous aussi, vous êtes bâtis avec les autres pour devenir une demeure pour Dieu, qui y habite par l’Esprit.
fr.R: Ainsi, maintenant, vous n’êtes plus des étrangers ni des gens du dehors. Vous êtes citoyens avec tout le peuple de Dieu, et vous faites partie de la famille de Dieu. \v 20 Vous êtes comme un bâtiment que Dieu est en train de construire. Les apôtres et les prophètes en sont les fondations, et le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} en est la pierre angulaire, la première pierre posée. \v 21 En {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, toute la construction est bien assemblée, et elle grandit pour devenir un temple saint, uni au Seigneur. \v 22 Et en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, vous aussi, vous êtes construits avec les autres pour devenir une maison où Dieu habite par l’Esprit.

ko.L: 그러므로 여러분은 이제 더 이상 외국인도 나그네도 아니요, 성도들과 함께 [한] 시민이며 하나님의 집안 식구입니다. \v 20 여러분은 사도들과 예언자들의 기초 위에 세워졌고, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 그분이 모퉁잇돌이 되십니다. \v 21 그분 안에서 건물 전체가 서로 연결되어 주님 안에서 거룩한 성전으로 자라 가고, \v 22 그분 안에서 여러분도 성령 안에서 하나님의 거처로 함께 지어져 가고 있습니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 여러분은 이제 더 이상 외국인이나 나그네가 아닙니다. 여러분은 하나님의 성도들과 함께 시민이며, 하나님의 집안 식구입니다. \v 20 여러분은 사도들과 예언자들이라는 기초 위에 세워졌고, 그 모퉁잇돌은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 그분이십니다. \v 21 그분 안에서 건물 전체가 서로 잘 맞추어져서 주님 안에서 거룩한 성전으로 자라 가고 있습니다. \v 22 그리고 그분 안에서 여러분도 다른 사람들과 함께 지어져 가서, 성령으로 하나님께서 사시는 집이 되어 가고 있습니다.
ko.R: 그러므로 이제 여러분은 더 이상 낯선 사람이나 바깥사람이 아닙니다. 여러분은 하나님의 모든 백성과 함께 시민이며, 하나님의 가족입니다. \v 20 여러분은 하나님께서 짓고 계시는 건물과 같습니다. 사도들과 예언자들이 그 건물의 기초이고, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 그분이 모퉁잇돌이십니다. \v 21 그분 안에서 건물 전체가 서로 잘 맞추어져서, 주님과 하나가 된 거룩한 성전으로 자라 가고 있습니다. \v 22 그리고 그분 안에서 여러분도 다른 사람들과 함께 지어져 가고 있습니다. 하나님께서 성령으로 사시는 집이 되어 가는 것입니다.

vi.L: Vậy, anh chị em không còn là khách lạ hay kiều dân nữa, nhưng là người đồng công dân với các thánh đồ và là người nhà của Đức Chúa Trời, \v 20 đã được xây dựng trên nền của các sứ đồ và các nhà tiên tri, mà chính {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu là đá góc nhà, \v 21 trong Đấng ấy cả tòa nhà, được ghép nối với nhau, đang lớn lên thành một đền thờ thánh trong Chúa, \v 22 trong Đấng ấy anh chị em cũng đang được xây dựng chung với nhau để trở thành nơi ngự của Đức Chúa Trời trong Thánh Linh.
vi.B: Vậy anh chị em không còn là khách lạ hay kiều dân nữa. Anh chị em là công dân cùng với dân thánh của Đức Chúa Trời, và là người trong gia đình của Đức Chúa Trời. \v 20 Anh chị em đã được xây dựng trên nền là các sứ đồ và các nhà tiên tri, và đá góc nhà chính là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}. \v 21 Trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, cả tòa nhà được ghép nối với nhau và đang lớn lên thành một đền thờ thánh trong Chúa. \v 22 Và trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, anh chị em cũng đang được xây dựng cùng với những người khác thành một ngôi nhà cho Đức Chúa Trời, là Đấng ngự ở đó bởi Thánh Linh.
vi.R: Vậy bây giờ anh chị em không còn là khách lạ hay người ngoài nữa. Anh chị em là công dân cùng với tất cả dân thánh của Đức Chúa Trời, và anh chị em là người trong gia đình của Đức Chúa Trời. \v 20 Anh chị em giống như một tòa nhà mà Đức Chúa Trời đang xây. Các sứ đồ và các nhà tiên tri là nền móng của tòa nhà ấy, còn chính Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} là đá góc nhà. \v 21 Trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, cả tòa nhà được ghép nối với nhau, và đang lớn lên thành một đền thờ thánh, gắn liền với Chúa. \v 22 Và trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, anh chị em cũng đang được xây dựng cùng với những người khác thành một ngôi nhà, nơi Đức Chúa Trời ngự bởi Thánh Linh.

pt.L: Assim, pois, vocês já não são estrangeiros e forasteiros, mas são concidadãos dos santos e membros da casa de Deus, \v 20 tendo sido edificados sobre o fundamento dos apóstolos e profetas, sendo a pedra angular o próprio {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} Jesus, \v 21 no qual todo edifício, sendo bem ajustado, cresce para [ser] um templo santo no Senhor, \v 22 no qual também vocês estão sendo edificados juntos para [ser] morada de Deus no Espírito.
pt.B: Por isso vocês já não são estrangeiros nem moradores sem cidadania. Vocês são cidadãos junto com o povo santo de Deus e pertencem à família de Deus. \v 20 Vocês foram edificados sobre os apóstolos e profetas como alicerce, e a pedra angular é o próprio {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} Jesus. \v 21 Nele todo o edifício, bem ajustado, vai crescendo até se tornar um templo santo no Senhor. \v 22 E {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}} também vocês estão sendo edificados junto com os outros para se tornarem uma casa para Deus, que mora ali pelo Espírito.
pt.R: Então agora vocês não são mais estrangeiros nem gente de fora. Vocês são cidadãos junto com todo o povo de Deus e fazem parte da família de Deus. \v 20 Vocês são como um prédio que Deus está construindo. Os apóstolos e os profetas são o alicerce, e o próprio {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} Jesus é a pedra angular. \v 21 Nele o prédio inteiro é bem ajustado e vai crescendo até se tornar um templo santo, unido ao Senhor. \v 22 E {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}} vocês também estão sendo construídos junto com os outros para formar uma casa onde Deus mora pelo Espírito.

am.L: እንግዲያስ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ እንግዶችና መጻተኞች አይደላችሁም፤ ነገር ግን ከቅዱሳን ጋር ዜጎችና የእግዚአብሔር ቤተ ሰብ አባላት ናችሁ፤ \v 20 በሐዋርያትና በነቢያት መሠረት ላይ ታንጻችሁ፣ የማዕዘን ድንጋዩ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ ራሱ ሆኖ፣ \v 21 በእርሱ ሕንጻው ሁሉ እየተገጣጠመ በጌታ ቅዱስ ቤተ መቅደስ ለመሆን ያድጋል፤ \v 22 በእርሱ እናንተ ደግሞ በመንፈስ የእግዚአብሔር ማደሪያ ለመሆን አብራችሁ ትታነጻላችሁ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ እንግዶችና መጻተኞች አይደላችሁም። ከእግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ሕዝብ ጋር አብራችሁ ዜጎች ናችሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቤተ ሰብ ናችሁ። \v 20 ሐዋርያትና ነቢያት መሠረት ሆነውላችሁ በእነርሱ ላይ ታንጻችኋል፤ የማዕዘን ድንጋዩም {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ ራሱ ነው። \v 21 ሕንጻው ሁሉ በእርሱ እየተገጣጠመ በጌታ ቅዱስ ቤተ መቅደስ ለመሆን ያድጋል። \v 22 እናንተም ደግሞ በእርሱ ከሌሎቹ ጋር ለእግዚአብሔር መኖሪያ ለመሆን አብራችሁ ትታነጻላችሁ፤ እርሱም በመንፈስ በዚያ ይኖራል።
am.R: ስለዚህ አሁን እንግዶች ወይም ባዕዳን አይደላችሁም። ከእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ሁሉ ጋር አብራችሁ ዜጎች ናችሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቤተ ሰብ ናችሁ። \v 20 እግዚአብሔር እንደሚሠራው ሕንጻ ናችሁ። ሐዋርያትና ነቢያት መሠረቱ ናቸው፤ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ ራሱም የማዕዘን ድንጋዩ ነው። \v 21 በእርሱ ሕንጻው ሁሉ ተገጣጥሟል፤ ከጌታም ጋር ተያይዞ ቅዱስ ቤተ መቅደስ ለመሆን ያድጋል። \v 22 በእርሱም እናንተ ደግሞ ከሌሎቹ ጋር አብራችሁ እግዚአብሔር በመንፈሱ የሚኖርበት ቤት ለመሆን ትታነጻላችሁ።

hi.L: इसलिए तुम अब परदेशी और प्रवासी नहीं रहे, पर पवित्र जनों के संगी नागरिक और परमेश्वर के घराने के हो, \v 20 और प्रेरितों और भविष्यद्वक्ताओं की नींव पर बनाए गए हो, जिसके कोने का पत्थर स्वयं मसीह यीशु हैं, \v 21 जिनमें सारी इमारत एक साथ जुड़कर प्रभु में एक पवित्र मन्दिर बनती जाती है, \v 22 जिनमें तुम भी आत्मा में परमेश्वर का निवास-स्थान होने के लिए एक साथ बनाए जा रहे हो।
hi.B: इसलिए अब तुम परदेशी और बाहर से आकर बसे हुए लोग नहीं रहे। तुम परमेश्वर के पवित्र लोगों के साथ संगी नागरिक हो, और परमेश्वर के घराने के हो। \v 20 तुम प्रेरितों और भविष्यद्वक्ताओं को नींव बनाकर उस पर बनाए गए हो, और कोने का पत्थर स्वयं मसीह यीशु हैं। \v 21 उन्हीं में सारी इमारत जुड़ती हुई प्रभु में एक पवित्र मन्दिर बनती जा रही है। \v 22 और उन्हीं में तुम भी दूसरों के साथ मिलकर परमेश्वर का घर बनाए जा रहे हो, जहाँ वे आत्मा के द्वारा रहते हैं।
hi.R: इसलिए अब तुम परदेशी या बाहरी लोग नहीं रहे। तुम परमेश्वर के सब लोगों के साथ संगी नागरिक हो, और परमेश्वर के परिवार का भाग हो। \v 20 तुम एक इमारत की तरह हो जिसे परमेश्वर खड़ा कर रहे हैं। प्रेरित और नबी उसकी नींव हैं, और मसीह यीशु स्वयं कोने का पत्थर हैं। \v 21 उन्हीं में सारी इमारत आपस में जुड़ी हुई है, और प्रभु से जुड़कर एक पवित्र मन्दिर बनती जा रही है। \v 22 और उन्हीं में तुम भी दूसरों के साथ मिलकर एक ऐसा घर बनाए जा रहे हो जहाँ परमेश्वर आत्मा के द्वारा रहते हैं।

ru.L: Итак, вы уже не иностранцы и не переселенцы, но сограждане святых и члены Божьего дома, \v 20 построенные на основании апостолов и пророков, где краеугольный камень — сам {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} Иисус, \v 21 в котором всё здание, слагаясь вместе, растёт в святой храм в Господе, \v 22 в котором и вы вместе строитесь в жилище Бога в Духе.
ru.B: Итак, вы больше не чужие и не иноземцы, живущие без прав. Вы сограждане святого народа Божьего и принадлежите к Божьему дому. \v 20 Вы построены на апостолах и пророках как на основании, а краеугольный камень — сам {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} Иисус. \v 21 В {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}} всё здание, слагаясь воедино, вырастает в святой храм в Господе. \v 22 И в {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}} вы тоже вместе с другими строитесь в дом для Бога, который живёт в нём Духом.
ru.R: Так что теперь вы больше не чужие и не посторонние. Вы граждане вместе со всем Божьим народом, и вы часть Божьей семьи. \v 20 Вы как здание, которое строит Бог. Апостолы и пророки — его основание, а сам {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} Иисус — краеугольный камень. \v 21 В {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}} всё здание соединено вместе и вырастает в святой храм, соединённый с Господом. \v 22 И в {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}} вы тоже вместе с другими строитесь в дом, где Бог живёт через Духа.

uk.L: Отже, ви вже не чужинці й поселенці, а співгромадяни святих і домашні Божі, \v 20 збудовані на основі апостолів і пророків, а наріжним каменем є сам {{christos:Христос|Месія}} Ісус, \v 21 у якому вся будівля, складаючись докупи, росте в святий храм у Господі, \v 22 у якому й ви разом будуєтеся в оселю Божу в Дусі.
uk.B: Тож ви вже не чужинці й не поселенці без прав громадян. Ви співгромадяни Божого святого народу і належите до Божого дому. \v 20 Ви збудовані на апостолах і пророках як на основі, а наріжний камінь — сам {{christos:Христос|Месія}} Ісус. \v 21 У {{deity_pronoun:ньому|Ньому}} вся будівля, щільно складена, зростає в святий храм у Господі. \v 22 І в {{deity_pronoun:ньому|Ньому}} ви також разом з іншими будуєтеся в оселю для Бога, який живе там через Духа.
uk.R: Тож тепер ви вже не чужі й не сторонні. Ви громадяни разом з усім Божим народом, і ви — частина Божої родини. \v 20 Ви — наче будинок, який будує Бог. Апостоли й пророки — його основа, а сам {{christos:Христос|Месія}} Ісус — наріжний камінь. \v 21 У {{deity_pronoun:ньому|Ньому}} вся будівля щільно поєднана, і вона росте в святий храм, зʼєднаний із Господом. \v 22 І в {{deity_pronoun:ньому|Ньому}} ви також разом з іншими будуєтеся в дім, де Бог живе через Духа.

ja.L: ですから、あなたがたはもはや外国人でも寄留者でもなく、聖なる者たちと同じ市民であり、神の家の者です。\v 20 使徒たちと預言者たちの土台の上に建てられ、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスご自身が隅石です。\v 21 その方にあって、建物全体が組み合わされて、主にあって聖なる神殿へと成長し、\v 22 その方にあって、あなたがたもまた、霊における神の住まいへと、ともに建てられているのです。
ja.B: ですから、あなたがたはもはや、外国人でも寄留者でもありません。神の聖なる民とともに同じ市民であり、神の家族の一員です。\v 20 あなたがたは、使徒たちと預言者たちを土台として建てられており、その隅石は{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスご自身です。\v 21 この方に結ばれて、建物全体はしっかりと組み合わされ、主に結ばれた聖なる神殿へと成長しています。\v 22 そして、あなたがたもこの方に結ばれて、ほかの人々とともに建てられ、神が霊によって住まわれる家となっていくのです。
ja.R: ですから、みなさんはもう、よそ者でも外から来た人でもありません。神のすべての民とともに同じ国の市民であり、神の家族の一員です。\v 20 みなさんは、神が建てておられる建物のようなものです。使徒たちと預言者たちがその土台で、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスご自身が隅の石です。\v 21 この方と一つにされて、建物全体はしっかりと組み合わされ、主と一つにされた聖なる神殿へと育っています。\v 22 そしてみなさんも、この方と一つにされて、ほかの人々とともに建てられています。神が聖霊によって住まわれる家となっていくのです。

decisions.choice: strangers and resident aliens: foreigners, and foreigners living in a place without a citizen's rights
decisions.reason: ξένοι are foreigners; πάροικοι are people who live in a city but are not its citizens and lack the rights citizens have. Both answer verse 12, where the readers were shut out from Israel's citizenship and strangers to its covenants.

decisions.choice: fellow citizens of the holy ones: citizens together with all God's people
decisions.reason: Ephesians uses ἁγίων for believers (1:1, 1:15, 3:8). The Gentile readers now share the citizenship of God's people with everyone who belongs to it, Jews who believe and Gentiles alike.

decisions.choice: household members: members of God's family
decisions.reason: οἰκεῖοι are those who belong to a household. The picture moves from the city (citizens) to the home (family), and then to the building itself (verses 20-22).

decisions.choice: the foundation of the apostles and prophets: the apostles and prophets themselves are the foundation
alternatives: the foundation the apostles and prophets laid, that is, their teaching
the prophets of the Old Testament
decisions.reason: One article covers both groups, and 3:5 and 4:11 speak of apostles and prophets in the church to whom Christ has now been revealed; the order, apostles first, points to prophets of the church rather than of the Old Testament. Whether the foundation is these people or the message they gave, the sense is close, since they were the first to receive and proclaim the revelation of Christ (compare Revelation 21:14).

decisions.choice: cornerstone: the first stone laid in the foundation, which fixes the line of the whole building
alternatives: capstone or top stone, which completes the building
decisions.reason: ἀκρογωνιαίου is a stone at the corner. The same word is used in the Greek Old Testament of Isaiah 28:16, for a precious stone laid in Zion's foundation, and 1 Peter 2:6 quotes that verse of Christ. That use, and the word "foundation" in this verse, favor a cornerstone. Others take it as the top stone that completes the building, linking it with "the head of the corner" in Psalm 118:22 and with the building growing up toward it in verse 21. Either way Christ is the stone on which the whole building depends.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "every building" without the article, meaning the whole building
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts add the article before οἰκοδομὴ, which makes "the whole building" plain. The SBLGNT follows important early manuscripts without it. Without the article πᾶσα usually means "every", but in the Greek of the time it can also mean "all" or "the whole" (Matthew 2:3). Since Paul speaks of one temple, the whole building is meant. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: a holy temple: the sanctuary where God lives, now his people
decisions.reason: ναὸν is the temple itself, the place of God's presence, not the courts around it. Paul calls God's people his temple (1 Corinthians 3:16-17; 2 Corinthians 6:16). Gentiles once kept out of the temple courts (verse 14) are now part of the temple.

decisions.choice: in whom: in Christ, both times
alternatives: in which: in the cornerstone or the building
decisions.reason: ᾧ refers back to Christ Jesus, the last person named, and κυρίῳ ("the Lord") in verse 21 is also Christ. The building grows and is built in union with him.

decisions.choice: a dwelling place of God in the Spirit: the home where God lives by his Spirit
alternatives: a spiritual dwelling place for God
decisions.reason: κατοικητήριον is a place to live. ἐν πνεύματι most naturally names the Spirit, as in verse 18: God lives among his people by the Spirit.

decisions.choice: resident foreigners (B); outsiders (R)
decisions.reason: The word means foreigners living in a place without citizen's rights (m1); "aliens" now often suggests beings from another world.

decisions.choice: belong to God's household (B); part of God's family (R)
alternatives: members of the household of God
decisions.reason: Readable uses the plainer word "family" (m3).

decisions.choice: You are like a building that God is putting up
decisions.reason: Readable introduces the picture of a building that the next verses use, and names God as the builder that the passive implies.

decisions.choice: You have been built on the apostles and prophets as your foundation, and the cornerstone is {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} (B)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the participle phrases full sentences, and keep the sense that the apostles and prophets are the foundation (m4).

decisions.choice: a home for God, who lives there by the Spirit (B); a home where God lives by the Spirit (R)
decisions.reason: "Home" is the everyday word for a place where someone lives (m9).

decisions.choice: wakazi wasio raia (L); wakazi wasio na haki za raia (B)
decisions.reason: πάροικοι live in a place without a citizen's rights (m1). Swahili has no single word for a resident foreigner, so it says "residents who are not citizens", which also prepares for "raia" (citizens) in the same verse.

decisions.choice: des résidents sans droits (L); des résidents sans droit de cité (B); des gens du dehors (R)
decisions.reason: The word is a foreigner who lives in a place without a citizen’s rights (m1). "Gens de passage" would say they did not stay; "immigrés" brings in modern debates. Balanced keeps "droit de cité" from verse 12.

decisions.choice: la pierre angulaire, la première pierre posée (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what a cornerstone is, the first stone laid, which fixes the line of the building (m5).

decisions.choice: "모퉁잇돌" at every level
decisions.reason: The cornerstone is the first stone laid in the foundation, which fixes the line of the building (the meaning decision). "모퉁잇돌" (corner stone) says that; "머릿돌" in current Korean is the dedication stone set in a finished building.

decisions.choice: "성전" for the temple at every level
decisions.reason: As in the Korean of John: "성전" names the sanctuary where God lives, here his people.

decisions.choice: "예언자" for the prophets at every level, through the letter
decisions.reason: The Korean style guide prefers the modern "예언자" to the older Protestant "선지자".

decisions.choice: "khách lạ hay kiều dân" (L, B); "khách lạ hay người ngoài" (R)
decisions.reason: The two words are foreigners, and foreigners living in a place without a citizen's rights (m1). "Kiều dân" is a foreign resident, which keeps the second sense; Readable says "outsiders".

decisions.choice: "đá góc nhà"
decisions.reason: The cornerstone is the first stone of the foundation, which fixes the line of the building (m5). "Đá góc nhà" is the everyday phrase; "đá đầu góc" is the older church form.

decisions.choice: "đền thờ" for the temple; "nơi ngự" (L), "ngôi nhà ... ngự" (B, R) for God's dwelling
decisions.reason: "Đền thờ" is the style guide's word for the temple, here God's people (m7). For God dwelling, Vietnamese uses the respectful "ngự", as the Vietnamese Romans does for God's Spirit (8:9).

decisions.choice: moradores sem cidadania
decisions.reason: The word means foreigners who live in a city without a citizen's rights (m1). "Peregrino" now suggests a pilgrim, and "imigrante" a modern status; Balanced says what they lacked, which prepares for "cidadãos" in the same verse.

decisions.choice: መጻተኞች (resident foreigners, L, B); ባዕዳን (outsiders, R)
decisions.reason: "መጻተኛ" is a foreigner who lives in a land without belonging to it, the sense of meaning decision m1; "ስደተኛ" would add flight from danger.

decisions.choice: የማዕዘን ድንጋይ (cornerstone)
decisions.reason: The stone laid first at the corner, which sets the line of the whole building (meaning decision m5); "የመሠረት ድንጋይ" is used in Amharic for any ceremonial first stone and would lose the corner.

decisions.choice: "भविष्यद्वक्ताओं" (L, B); "नबी" (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's key term for prophet: the established word at Literal and Balanced, the everyday "नबी" at Readable. The same through the letter.

decisions.choice: "कोने का पत्थर"
decisions.reason: The first stone laid in the foundation, which fixes the line of the whole building (meaning decision m5). The Greek word differs from the "head of the corner" of Matthew 21:42 ("कोने का मुख्य पत्थर").

decisions.choice: храм, lower case
decisions.reason: The style guide capitalises "Храм" for the Temple in Jerusalem; here the temple is God's people (m7), so it is written in lower case.

decisions.choice: сам {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} Иисус, without a pronoun setting
decisions.reason: The intensive "сам" takes no setting; the English has it on "Himself".

decisions.choice: домашні Божі (L); Божий дім (B); Божа родина (R)
alternatives: члени Божої родини at every level
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek's "members of the household"; Balanced "належите до Божого дому" keeps the house image that runs on into the building of verses 20-22; Readable says family.

decisions.choice: "寄留者" (L, B); "外から来た人" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is a foreigner living in a city without a citizen's rights (m1). 寄留者 is the established word for that standing; Readable says it plainly. 市民 at every level answers 市民権 in 2:12 (m6).

decisions.choice: "隅石" (L, B); "隅の石" (R)
decisions.reason: The cornerstone laid in the foundation, as in Isaiah 28:16 (m5). 要石 and かしら石 would choose the other reading, a top stone; 礎石 loses the corner. Readable spells the word out for easier reading.

decisions.choice: "建物全体" (L)
decisions.reason: Without the article the Greek can mean "every building", but Paul speaks of one temple, so the whole building is meant (m6). Japanese すべての建物 would suggest many buildings, so Literal says 建物全体 too.
